rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /༄tsho/ /lung rtogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 7kun dga' tshul khrims dpal bzang po gang gi rnam par thar ba cha shas tsam brjod pa grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhu/sda so/ / (—3 chiwapyidubyesnge lnge di—ritsho— kāX rtetweri(ri ༷wazurdosne rdo (4〉 ci1 ——jurdochi— — zi ༷ngh+ru+o —3 ༷— ༷ 4— — rnyisne

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ardzo ba'i bum bzang /༄gyi/ /na mo gu ru badz+ra dha ra ye/rgyal kun chos dbyings 'khor 'das dwangs ma'i bcud/ /rnam kun mtshan dpe'i dpal mnga' gzhom med gsung / /bde stong ye shes thugs kyi dpal be'ur 'khyil/ /bla ma rdo rje 'chang dbang snying nas 'dud/ /gangs ljongs mkhas grub bye ba'i gtsug gi nor/ /rgyal ba'i lung gis bsngags pa'i me tog 'thor/ /gzhan stong dbu ma'i srol 'byed jo nang pa/ /yab sras brgyud 'dzin bcas la gus phyag 'tshal/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bdag /kun dga' tshul khrims rgya mtsho dpal bzang po/ /gang gi rnam thar cha shas brjod pa la/ /khong ni rgyal kun dbyings dang mi gnyis par/ /rang cag lta bus yul las 'das na yang / /skyabs rje nyid la slob bu 'ga' zhig gis/ /rnam thar gsung zhes gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ /3

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /nyid kyi zhal nas rang nyid rnam thar ni/ /'bri ba'i gnas min gsungs nas ma gnang kyang / /yang yang nan zhu byas ngor phyis su ni/ /zhal bzhes cung tsam gnang ba 'di skad du/ /a ho skye sngon dge spyod smon lam bzang btab mthus/ /da lta dal 'byor rten thob bla ma dang / /dam chos mjal nas dge la spyod tshul byas/ /phyi mu ji 'dra 'ong snyam yi re mug /rang gi gnas tshul rnam thar rang gis 'bri/ /zhes sogs bris kyang legs par mtha' ma rdzogs//rjes su nye gnas sogs dang slob bu 'gas/ /nyid kyi gsung dang gzhan las thos pa rnams/ /mdo tsam bris zhes rang la bskul ba yi/ / rkyen gyi dbang gis zol bstod sgro 'dogs dang / /bral ba'i drang bo'i tshul gyis cung zad brjod/ /de la thog mar mdo rgyud rnams su yang / /skyabs gsum kun 'dus bla mar bsngags pa ni/ /4

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /dgyes pa rdo rje r+sā po'i rgyud de las/ /gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes/ /gang du yang ni mi rnyed de/ /bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pa dang / /bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya/ /zhes gsungs sgyu 'a/glul dra ba las/ /slob dpon ji ltar blta zhe na/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /de nyid rtag tu rdo rje 'chang / /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog /de nyid ye shes rgya mtsho ste/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen sbyin/ / slob dpon gyi ni yon to bzung / /skyon ni nam yang ma yin no/ /yon to bzung bas dngos grub cing / /skyon rnams kyis ni dngos grub nyams/ /de yi grib ma'ang mi 'gom ste/ /5

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /mchod rten bzhig dang 'dra bar gsungs/ /rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las kyang / /slob dpon ston par gyur pa ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag mdzad pa/ /bdag cag rnams kyi pha dang ma/ /'di nyid yid la bsam par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' ci lta bus/ /de ltar slob dpon gzugs 'dzin te/ /sems can rjes su gzung dmigs nas/ /phal ba'i gzugs su gnas pa'o/ /dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ /slob dponagyis ni sdig pa 'phrog /slob dpon gyis ni 'jigs pa sel/ /slob dpon gyis ni sdug bsngal gyi/ /rgya mtsho'i 'jings las sgrol bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs iṇ+ḍa bhu ti yis / /rkyal ba 'dzin pa med par ni/ /6

rnam thar grub gnyitsho'ajo ba'i bum bzang /gru yis pha rol 'gro mi 'gyur/ /yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs kyang / /bla ma med par srid mthar min / /mthu stobs dbang phyug bir wa pas/ /bla ma dang ni rdo rje sems/ /tha dad par ni mi bya ste/ /bla ma sangs rgyas chos dang ni/ /de bzhin dge 'dun bla ma ste/ /dngos grub go 'phang mchog 'dod pa'i/ /kun nas bla ma mnyes par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos rdo rje 'chang / /rtsod pa'i dus 'dir bdag don du/ /kun dang mthun par ston mdzad pa/ /de ltar shes nas dngos kun gyis/ /bsten bya dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /dngos grub bde chen thob par 'gyur//gsang 'dus rim lnga'i rgyud las kyang / /7

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /mchod pa thams cad yongs spungs nas/ /bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsams/ /de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen gyi/ /ye shes mchog ni 'thob par 'gyur/ /bla med byed pa slob dpon gyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mchod byas pas/ /de yis bsod nams ma byas shing / /dka' thub ma bsten gang zhig yod/ /de nyid mi bzad 'dod pa yis/ /shin tu yid 'ong gang dang gang / /shin tu khyad par gyur pa nyid/ /de dang de ni bla mar 'bul/ /de ltar bla ma sangs rgyas kun 'dus su/ /rang gis mthong nas ci gsungs sgrub pa yang / /dam bca' lhod med srog ltar bsrungs pas na/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub la thag mi ring/ /da ni gang gi rnam thar brjod pa yang / /8

rnam thar grub gnyispo'ajo ba'i bum bzang /'khrungs yul rdo smad dgra bla'i rga la ku /yab ni tig tsha chos kyi mgon po dang / /ma yum lha za sgron skyid gnyis po la/ /bu mo gcig ni skyes nas shi song bas /lo 'gar sras ma 'khrungs bas yab yum gnyis/ /sems sdug byas nas mo dang rtsis byas tshe/ /lad pa dgu bcos 'don zhing dbang thang gi /rgya ma'i thang ga lha khang bzang po bzhengs/ /de yi nang la ston pa gtso 'khor gsum/ /gnas brtan bcu drug 'jim sku gru re tsam/ /legs par bzhengs te khrus gsol gtsang sbra dang / /rab gnas brtan bzhugs la sogs 'grub gyur na/ /skyes bu dam pa zhig ni 'khrungs zer bas/ /de ltar legs par grub nas mi ring bar /yum gyi lhums su zhugs skabs yab yum gnyis/ /rmi lam ltas bzang ngo mtshar mang po byung / /rab rgyal chu khyi lo yi zla tshes la/ /9

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /yum la zug zer med cing dga' bde'i ngang / /ngo mtshar du ma'i ltas bcas sku bltams so/ /de nas dgung grangs gcig par byis chung de/ /byis pa gzhan dang mi 'dra khyad chos can/ /yin pa yul mi kun la mthun snang byung / /byis pa'i ming la tshe 'dzin zhes kyang gsol/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras 'jig rten 'dir 'khrungs tshe/ /'gro kun bde skyid dpal gyi snang ba dang / /rgyal bstan gsal ba'i zla ba yar gyi tshes/ /gnas skabs mthar thug dge legs kun 'byung ba/ /dpag bsam ljon pa'i myu gu gsar du zhabrungs/ /de dang chabs cig nag phyogs bdud sde'i tshogs/ /snying la mi bzad zug rngu 'byung ba ni/ /rgyal sras 'jig rten byon pa'i chos nyid yin/ /dgung lo gnyis par dgra bla'i ri khrod der/ /'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sprul ba 'ba' mda' rje/ /thub bstan dge legs rgya mtsho bzhugs pa'i drung / /10

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /yab kyis byis pa tshe 'dzin khrid nas song / /skyabs rje dam pa gang gis byis chung nyid/ /skyes sbyangs yon tan can zhig yin dgongs nas/ /'di nyid rtsog mnol ma btang gtsang sbra gyis/ /skyes bu dam pa zhig 'ong lung bstan nas/ /rten 'brel legs pa'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i ched/ /ka mad sum cu lhung bshags yi ge gnang / /nyid kyis byin rlabs ljags khrid sogs kyang mdzad/ /dgung lo gsum par na tshod chung na yang / /skye sngon mchog gsum skyabs gnas snying nas bsten/ /'gro kun pha mar shes pa'i byams brtse yis/ /lhag bsam go cha brtan po nyer bgos te/ /skye dgu sku bzhi'i go 'phang dbang bsgyur ched/ /rgyal sras rlabs chen spyod pa'i lam bzang der/ /brtson pa drag pos legs par rab zhugs te/ /tshogs gnyis bsags dang smon lam sgo 'bum phrag /grangs med mngon gyur skyes bu dam pa yi/ /11

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang / mdzad spyod gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa ni/ /lhar bcas kun gyis bsnyon du ma mchis so/ /dgung lo bzhi pa'i steng la sngon chad du/ /rigs ldan sprul pa rat+na shri yis/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i dgra bla'i ri khrod der/ /yul mi thams cad lo tshigs re re bzhin/ /bsnyen gnas yod pas lo de'i bsnyen gnas skabs/ /skyes chen dam pa bla ma pad+ma bzang / /rang rig rnam gnyis bka' bgros legs byas pas/ /rigs ldan byis chung tshe 'dzin 'di nyid ni/ /dam pa gong ma'i yang sprul yin nges pas/ /khri 'don dgos zhes rdo dang spang leb kyi/ /khri brtsegs mdun cog rdo leb byas pa'i steng / /phye rtsam phye mar dang bcas bkra shis pa'i/ /rdzas dang zas mchog rnams ni legs par bsgrigs/ /bla ma pad+ma bzang gi paṇa zhwa dang / /chos gos bskon nas mi 'jigs rdo rje'i khrir/ /12

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /mnga' gsol mdzad pas kun mkhyen jo nang ba'i/ /bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mchog la dbang bsgyur gang / /phun tshogs legs pa'i sgo 'phar phyes dang lhan/ /bla ma rnam gnyis gtsor bcas 'dus sde yis/ /bkra shis tshigs bcad rten 'brel snying po dang / /yangs ba'i grong khyer 'jug pa'i shis brjod gnang / /der gnas kun gyis mthong tshe bla ma 'di/ /su yin zer tshe chos mgon tshang gi bu/ /tshe 'dzin yin zhes der gnas thams cad kyis/ /rtsa dkar rigs bzang yin zhes gleng mo byas/ /khong gis sprul sku yin khul byas 'dug gsung / /dgung mo khri 'bo ja gzhong gang tsam gnang / /rgyal kun thugs bskyed 'od stong bdag po yis/ /'gro blos rmongs mun lhag med gzhom dang lhan/ /rgyal bstan snying po'i 'dab brgya lhug par bkrol/ /nges gsang don gyi ro bcud ze'u 'bru ngom/ /dgung lo lnga par dgra bla'i ri khrod der/ /13

rnam thar grub gnyiga'ajo ba'i bum bzang /bsnyung gnas ran tshe yul mi kun gyis kyang/ /khyed rang byon zhes rdzim cha ci dgos dris/ /ja re khyer shog zer nas nga rang gis/ /lho ja bar khag gsum tsam bzung song bas/ /yab kyis bka' bkyon gnang ba bdag gis dran/ /bar mtshams yul khams kun la jag rkun dang / /mu ge byung ba'i khyad par rang gi khyim/ /longs spyod dbul te sdug bsngal cung tsam myong / /dgung lo drug pa'i steng du rang cag dang / /yab yum rnams ni bde bar gnas pa'i ngang / /yum la nad med byis pa gcig skyes te/ /de yi ming la kun rab ces kyang btags/ /yul khams mu ge jag rkun sogs kyi dbang / /'byor ba mar mar zhan kyang nga rang gi /pha ma bka' drin can gnyis thabs bkod la/ /mkhas pa'i dbang gis nged cag pha bu la/ /dka' ngal ha cang ma byung bde bar gnas/ /14

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /dgung lo bdun par son pa'i dus skabs su/ /yab yum rnams ni bde bar gnas na yang / /bar skabs shig la mi 'dod pa yi rkyen/ /thog tu babs te yum la rgya cham gyis/ /thebs te yun ring ma lon dus las 'das/ /de yi rkyen gyis rang cag pha bu gsum/ /a khu a ne+e la sogs mdza' bshes kun/ /sdug bsngal gyis non yum gyi sngas bla rtswa /skyabs mgon sbyangs ba'i yang sprul dam pa rje/ /kun dga' dpal gyi snying po grwa 'khor bcas/ /byon nas khrus chab 'pho ba la sogs gnang / /ma 'das mchog sprul dam pa gang nyid ni/ /dang por mthong tshe nga rang bsam pa la/ /kun spyod legs shing sku gzugs yag pa zhes/ /sems la smra mi shes pa'i dga' ba dang / /lus nas ba spu g.yo ba'i dad pa gnyis/ /phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du gsal bo byung / /15

rnamothar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /de ni dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /sngon gyi las 'brel zab mo'i mthu dbang gis/ /bla slob mchog tu 'gyur ba'i snga ltas so/ /ma rgan 'pho rten mdzo mo dkar yol bcas/ /legs par phul te sprul sku grwa 'khor rnams/ /rang yul 'dzam thang phyogs la phebs pa sogs/ /nged rang byis pa bsam med gnyis po ni/ /ma rgan la yang sdug bsngal gyis non no/ /dgung lo brgyad thog nged cag pha bu gsum/ /zas gos sogs kyis dka' ngal mang po byung / /shing bzo rgan po zhig yod de nyid la/ /shing bzo bslabs nas dang po ṣ+ka mi dang / /gzhong ba la sogs bzhog nasabatsong ba yi/ /de yi rin gyis zas gos kha snon byas/ /de 'dra'i las kyis zhag 'gar kha zas 'tshol /dgung lo dgu par sngar ltar shing bzo dang / /bya ba thams cad sngar las 'bad pa byas/ /16

rnam tharazub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /'o zo mdong mo la sogasabazhogasanas btsong /khyim tshes rgan po bar bar rngon par song / /ha cang bsad mkhan zhig ni ma yin kyang / /thon tshe rang re gnyis kyis ja bskol 'dug /shing bzo nged gnyisares mos shing cha sogs/ /btu ru song nas shing bzo byasapa yi/ /rin gyis kha zasa'atshol te bde bar snang / /dgung lo bcu pa'i steng tsam tshe sngon gyis/ /bsod nams dman pa'i rkyen gyi yul khams la/ /mu ge rkun jag sogs kyis ma bzod nas/ /yul de'i mang phyogs sa mthar 'khyam dgos byung / /ngas ni sngar bzhin shing bzo byas nas ni/ /zas gos la sogs 'tshol ba'i dus skabs su/ /nga rang rkang nad thebs nas yun ring na/ /sman dang sngags gyis rim bzhin dwangs nas song / /ha cang bde ba med kyang pha bu gsum/ /rang cag 'dzoms nas tshor bde'i snang ba byung / /17

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /dgung lo bcu gcig pha bu gsum po'i nang / /nga rang pha rgan tshab byas bza' dpon byas/ /nu bo kun rab kyis ni pha rgan bsrung / /nged tsho'i rong 'brog gnyis la rkun jag gis/ /ca lag ci yod thams cad khyer nas song / /nga rang sngar ltar 'bad rtsol byas pa yis/ /pha bu gsum po'i lto gos la sogs tshol/ /dgung lo bcu gnyis steng tsam yul mi kun/ /sa mthar bud tshe nged cag ma tshugs par/ /de nas rim bzhin 'dzi yul phyogs su 'ong / /sngon nas bu chung kun rab 'dzi srib kyi/ /gyang nag tshang gi bu yin grags pa'i skyen/ /gyang nag tshang gi mtha' ru nged cag song / /rang gis shing bzo dang ni sprang zas kyis/ /nged rang sto gos byas te bde bar gnas/ /dgung lo bcu gsum son skabs sngar bzhin du/ /sprang glas zas gos byas te gyang nag tshang / /18

rnam thar grub gnyisa'adzo ba'i bum bzang /mtha' la bde bar gnas tshe skye sngon gyi/ /smon lam stobs dang dkar bo dge ba yis/ /las kyi mthur brten yi ge bslab 'go bzung / /kun rdzob 'ja' ris ri mo cher bkra bas/ /don gyi yin lugs rmongs mun rab zhugs pa/ /bdag sogs 'gro ba'i yid snang tshul mthun pa'i/ /brjod bya 'di yis don la reg par byos/ /dgung lo bcu bzhir dpal ldan 'dzam thang du/ /thon nas khang dmar gtsug lag rten khang du/ /sbyangs ba ma 'das mchog sprul rin po che/ /kun dga' dpal gyi snying po gang nyid kyis/ /bde mchog dbang skur skabs dang thug pa'i tshe/ /gzhan gyis khyed rang nyan shog bzang zer bas/ /nga la dbang rten ci yang med byas kyang / /skyon med khyod kyi me tog 'thus shig zer/ /gnas der khur bo phog nas me togabacad/ /chos 'brel thog ma yin snyam nga rang gis/ /19

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /lus ngag yid gsum me tog rnams phul nas/ /bde mchog dbang thob de nas grwa nang la/ /sprang nas ma 'das mchog sprul rin po che/ /gang gi mdun du song tshe khong nyid kyis/ /tshogs khug nang la rtsam pa yod do cog /nga yi khug ma'i nang la byos nas gnang / /ma dag pa yi snang ngor de ltar la/ /dag pa'i snang bar sku gsung thugs yon tan/ /'phrin las byin rlabs ma lus mtha' dag kun/ /bum pa gang byos ltar gnang der tshogs kyi/ /skya ser kun la mjal kha legs par gnang / /de tshe sngon chad nged gnyis byang phyogs kyi/ /sham+bha la nasabyon pa yin zhes pas/ /da lta rten 'brel legs pa 'dzom gsungs nas/ /sbyangs sprul rin po che nyid zhal 'dzum mdzad/ /dgung lo bco lngayisteng la sngon pha kyi/ /bag chags dbang gis nged rang pha bu gsum/ /20

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /'dzam thang phyogs su yar la spar nas 'ong / /zas sogs sprang nas kha zas kha thon byas/ /mang phyogs yig sprang bslab zhor 'bad pa byas/ /skye ba sngon mas smon lam mthu btsan dang / /bag chags rkyen gyis tsha kho'i nang nyid la/ /'byu rigs mang ba thos pa'i tshe de la/ /de la 'gro dgos bsam pa'i snang ba skyes/ /dgung lo bcu drug sngar bzhin yig sprang byas/ /dka' ngal med pa'i ngang la chos spyod sogs/ /phal cher sbyangs ba mthar phyin lo de yi/ /ston dgun phyogs la tsha khor nas bsod song / /'dza' 'gos ri khrod bla ma tshul khrims dang / /rdo rje slob dpon r+sā po dge mchog la/ /yang yang mjal zhing 'dza' 'gos nas bzung ste/ /'gram dang rga gyes tse le sgang la sogs/ /song nas de ru 'bri rigs rnyed pa bzang /de rjes pā lar sde sna'i gru la 'bud/ /21

rnam thar grub gnyispo'ajo ba'i bum bzang /grong sprang byas nas 'bru rigs mang po rnyed/ /slar log gru ba rgan po'i rtsar thon tshe/ /rang la bzang bzang byas nas gla ma blangs/ /slar yang ri khrod byang chub chos rdzong thon/ /dgung lo bcu bdun steng la son pa'i tshe/ /zla dang po'i yar tshes bzang po la/ /ri khrod bla ma dge mchog rin po ches/ /mdun du bos nas zhal ta bzang po gnang / /ri khrod smon lam chen mo mjal snyam nas/ /zhag 'gar 'dug tshe bla ma tshul khrims dang / /bla ma dge mchog rnam gnyis thugs brtse'i ngang / /nga rang mdun du yang nas yang du bos/ /smon lam chen mo'i ring la gnyer khang du/ /'dug nas rgyun du ja thug sogs la spyod/ /rnyed pa 'bru rigs chud tshad khur bo byas/ /nas sran bre bzhi tsam yang ma khyogs nas/ /bla ma dge mchog tshang gi nyi ra yi/ /22

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /nang la bcol nas slar yang nga rang nyid/ /rim bzhin 'dzam thang phyogs su yar la thon/ /nged rang pha bu gsum po mnyam 'dzom byung / /'di skor zhig la skyabs mgon dam pa rje/ /sprul sku kame bzang skyong gang nyid kyi/ /mdun nas nyid kyi rmi lam 'od gsal du/ /o rgyan rin po che yis gnang ba yi//tshe dbang dam pa mchog ni rang la thob/ /ma ṇi bla ma pad+ma sirnyi yi/ /mdun nas ma ṇi thugs rje chen po'i dbang / /tshe dbang bsnyen gnas lung rnams bdag la thob/ /dam pa bla ma rin chen dar rgyas kyi/ /mdun nas bsnyen gnas lung rnams cha tshang gsan/ /dgung lo bco brgyad sngar bas don gnyer byas/ /yi ge che rim dus 'khor la sogs pa/ /don rig zur bslab yig chod bzang tsam thon/ /nged rang pha bu rnams la sngar nas kyang / /23

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /zas sgoms ngan pa'i rkyen byas pha rgan la/ /slo nad thebs nas sman dang bsrung ba ni/ /rang re rnams kyis ci 'dzom 'bad nas byas/ /nga dang nu bo kun rab nged gnyis ni/ /res mos byas te grong ba so so la/ /gang rnyed sto gos ched du sprang nas btsal/ /dus mchod chen mo sa ga zla ba dang / /jo nang drug mchod chen mo'i dus skabs su/ /grwa nang sogs la sprang nas kha zas byas/ /dgung lo bcu dgur yi ge sna tshogs kyang / /mtha' ru phyin par mdzad nas bar bar du/ /grong chog sogs la song nas kha zas ni/ /cung zad rnyed de nu bo kun rab kyang / /don rig zur la yi ge sbyang ched bzung / /de ltar dam pa gang gi rnam thar ni/ /bka' gdams gong ma'i mdzad spyod ji bzhin du/ /blo phugs chos gtad chos phugs sprang la gtad/ /24

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /ngo mtshar gtam gyi dbyar rnga'i sgra bsgrag tshe/ /srid gsum gdul bya mdongs mtha' dga' ba'i gar/ /ci dgar rtsen bzhin yon tan mngal gyis lci/ /don gnyis 'bra bu 'byung ba'i ngo mtshar med/ /dgung lo nyi shu'i steng la thon pa'i tshe/ /nged sang khyim med gnas med lo 'gar song / /de yis rkyen byas bsam blo btang nas ni/ /rdo khog khang zhing thams cad dgos med par/ /sems te pha dang nu bo gnyis la yang / /gros byas nga rang rdo khog rga la gus/ /de ru song nas sa zhid khang pa rnams/ /rang gis dpon la cung zad ma zhus par/ /rang gi thag chod byas nas lkog tu btsong / /khang pa sa zhing btsong ba'i rin la rta/ /rgya ra gcig dang phying ba pa li gcig /khug nas myur bar 'dzam thang phyogs la yong / /skad cha de dag phyis su rdo smad kyi/ /25

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /ji bzhin dpon gyis thos tshe nga rang gi /thog la khrims bshad mang po byas gsung skad/ /rang lo nyer gcig zla ba dang po yi/ /tshes gcig pha rir sbyangs pa skyabs mgon gyi/ /sgrub khang nang du sgrol mar 'tshogs sar song / /ma ṇi bla ma pad+ma bde chen gyi/ /mdun nas tshe dbang thugs rje chen po yi/ /dbang the(gas legs par gsan nas a pha la /gros byas nga rang spyor drug 'dug dgos zhes/ /de nas bzung ste zas gos 'tshol phyir du/ /grong chog sogs la 'bad rtsol du ma byas/ /rang gzhan sgrib gnyis spyong la ches bsngags pa / /sa zla'i dus mchod skabs su nga rang zhugs/ /grub chen nag po spyod pa'i rnam 'phrul rje/ /skyabs mgon phur rtsa bla ma ngag gi dbang / /dkon mchog dar rgyas mdun nas nga rang gis/ /kun rig rnam par snang mdzad dbang yang gsan/ /26

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /dbyar khar mar bsod byas nas rnyed pa bzang / /de yi ston khar nas bsod byas pa yis/ /thun zas sogs kyi mthun rkyen legs par 'dzoms/ /jo nang drug mchod chen mo'i 'tshogs su zhugs/ /gza' skar 'phrod spyor 'dzoms pa'i nyin zhig la/ /gong ma'i sgrub gnas khang dmar pho brang du/ /kun gyi gtsug rgyan rdo rje slob dpon che/ /kun dga' bsod nams rgya mtsho'i mdun song nas/ /lus ngag yid gsum dge tshogs ci yod pa/ /dar dang bcas pa maṇ+ḍal rten byas te/ /skyabs sems khrid gnang phyag dang sems bskyed 'dug /spyan ras gzigs dbang sbyangs pa ma 'das nyid/ /khang dmar byon te dus 'khor lha dgu'i dbang / /rdor sems bzlas lung dang bcas legs par gnang / /de nas rim par rdor sems sgom bzlas skabs/ /stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bshags pa nan tan byas/ /lo mjug dgu gtor bskang gso sngar ltar bsgrub/ /27

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /byis pa'i dus nas dgung lo nyer gcig bar/ /khong gi rnam thar mdo tsam brjod pa 'di/ /nyid kyi zhal gsungs tshad mas gzhi byas so/ /dgung lo nyer gnyis steng la maṇ+ḍal gyi/ /khrid zhes tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho bsag ched du/ /phyi nang gsang gsum maṇ+ḍal nan tan byas/ /bla rnam gong 'og bar gsum bzhugs skabs su/ /drin can bla ma rdo rje 'chang de la/ /sangs rgyasadangos mthong mos gus tshad med skyes/ /de nas thun min sngon 'gro gnyis po yang / /tshul bzhin nyams len gnang tshe thog mar du/ /bskyed rim dus 'khor lhan skyes la bzhugs skabs/ /lha sku'i nga rgyal gsal snang brtan po byung / /zla ba gsum par gza' skar bzang po la/ /skyabs rje dam pa rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /kun dga' 'asod nams rgya mtsho gang nyid kyi/ /mdun nas mchog dbang gong mas byin rlabs dang / /28

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /bla ma'i man ngag dang bcas legs gnang nas/ /mun khang 'jug ste dben gsum sor sdud la/ /bzhugs skabs ngo mtshar 'od gsal rtags bcu yi/ /rnam pa mang po byung tshe bla ma la/ /zhus tshe gang thugs dgyes bzhin 'di ltar du/ /shog dang bzangagasungasagazengasabastod legasaparaganang / /bsam gtan brgya zhag bzhugs skabs yan lag lnga'i/ /rtogs pa rim bzhin thugs la legs par 'khrungs/ /srog rtsol zhag brgya bzhugs skabs ro rkyang gi /rlung rnams dbu mar thim pa'i rtags mtshan byung / /dgung lo nyer gsum son pa'i dus skabs su/ /'khrul 'khor 'pho bar bzhugs nas zla ba lnga'i/ /nang la 'brul luboragong ma nas grol te/ /'di skor zhig la rdo rje slob dpon mchog /kun dga' bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas/ /dus 'khor dbang chen nyin bdun legs par bskur/ /dus 'khor rgyud 'grel phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi/ /29

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /mchan can zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi/ /khrid yig chen mo mthong ba don ldan dang / /de yi lhan 'thab 'od brgya 'bar ba dang / /zung 'jug rab gsal ngo sprod phyi nang dang / /rtags tshad gegs sel 'khrul 'khor rtsa 'grel bcas/yan lag drug pa'i snying po stan gcig ma/ /sngon 'gro rjes khrid sogs kyi lung rnams dang / /sbyangs ba bla ma'i rnam thar gtor chog dang / /bla mchod bskang gsol 'phrin las rnam rol gyi/ /lung sogs gsan nas kun mkhyen rnam 'phrul rje/ /sbyangs ba ma 'das mchog sprul rin po che/ /kun dga' blo gros dpal gyi snying po yi/ /mdun nas khong dang ser mo 'ga' zhig gis/ /rta phyag khyung gsum rjes gnang legs par gsan/ /yi dam 'byung po 'dul byed khrid gnang nas/ /bsnyen tshad kha skong sbyin bsregs dang bcas grub/ /drug mchod 'tshogs nas zla ba bcu pa yi/ /30

rnam thar grub gnyis 'ardzo ba'i bum bzang /yar tshes bcu gsum zhabrul 'khor 'og mar bzhugs/ /sngon 'gro sor bsam sgom pa sngon btang nas/ /paṇa chen zla mgon lugs kyi srog rtsol sogs/ /rim par bzhugs nas lnga pa'i tshes bcu la/ /tshogs 'khor rgya chen 'pho ba rjes khrid bcas/ /yan lag drug po'i nyams len mthar phyin mdzad/ /mi rtog ye shes bser bu rab bskyod pas/ /glo bur chu 'dzin stug po mthar mdzad de/ / dri med lhan skyes mkha' dbyings dwangs ma'i gzhir/ /don dam rnam kun nyi zla'i 'od snang bkra/ /dgung lo nyer bzhi'i smad kyi dus tsam la/ /khang dmar bla ma bsod nams rgya mtsho yis/ /dus 'khor dbang chen nyin bdun gsung ba thob/ /de nas sman pa 'gab ma tshang de la/ /sgrol ma'i a mchod bzhugs skabs nyin zhig la/ /nyin gong gsol ja bzhes skabs zhal bu'i nang / /ja tshan blugs pa'i steng la khug rta zhes/ /31

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /srin bu gzhog pa can zhig lhung ba'i tshe/ /khong gis spyan btsum ja yun tsam bzhugs nas/ /slar yang spyan phyes phyag gis 'bu blangs nas/ /sangs rgyas mtshan dang byin rlabs byas pa'i mthar/ /'bu yang yar lang nam mkhar 'phur nas song / /bza' mi rnams kyi de mthong ngo mtshar zhing / /grub rtags yin zhes kun kyang ha las so/ /'di skor zhig la lha tse sprul sku yi/ /mdun nas 'od dpag med pa'i myur lam dbang / /mgon po tshogs bdag rjes gnang legs par gsan/ /dgung lo nyer lnga'i skor du rdo grub kyi/ /yang sprul yar lung mchog sprul rin po che'i/ /mdun nas rigs 'dus dbang gi thog ma yin/ /zhi khro'i dbang gi sta gon dngos gzhi'i dbang / /bka' gdams phugs nor bcu yi lung rnams gsan/ /de yi dgun khar nu bo kun rab kyang / /spyor drug bzhag nas khong gis zas gos kyi/ /3lha

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /mthun rkyen sbyar zhor bsnyen mtshams 'ga' re bzhugs/ /zhi chen kun bzang nyi ma'i zhal snga nas/ /gter ston gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gi /gter kha bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi/ /dbang dang gzhan yang po ti bzhi tsam lung / /karma gling ba'i gter kha'i thos grol gyi/ /dbang lung gsan cing le'u bdun ma dang / /rig 'dzin tshe dbang mchog grub dam pa rjes/ /gsung gi khrid yig bskyed rim spyi 'dus kyi/ /bshad pa zung 'jig snye ma'i lung rnams gsan/ /dgung lo nyer drug skabs su dus 'tshogs rnams/ /rim bzhin legs par tshogs nas dbyar gnas bzhugs/ /dung dkar sprul sku nges don rgya mtsho yi/ /mdun nas rgyal ba'i bka' chos chen mo yi/ /ljags lung sgra dbyangs drug 'gyur sgo nas thob/ /gzhan yang bka' brgyad mgon po seng gdong dang / /gu drag le'u bdun ma sogs lung rnams thob/ /33

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /sbyangs sprul blo gros bstan pa'i snying po yi/ /mdun nas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po che/ /kun mkhyen rton pa bzhi ldan chen po mchog /dol po shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ /gang gi gsung 'bum rdzogs ldan chos mchog gi /bka' pod drug dang gang gi rnam thar mchog /gsal ba'i sgron me bcas kyi lung rnams gsan/ /dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnam rol ba/ /rje btsun tā ra nā tha gang nyid kyi/ /bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs 'thor bu dang bcas pa/ /po ti nyer bzhi tsam gyi lung rnams thob/ /dus 'khor lha dgu'i dbang dang dus 'khor gyi/ /rdzogs rim dang 'brel mchog gi dbang gong ma/ /snga 'gyur gsang sngags rnying ma chen po yi/ /mgon po tshogs bdag gsang sgrub rjes gnang dang / /smin gling rgyal chen sku lnga'i sgog gtad dang / /rgya gar slob dpon dha na shri yi/ /34

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /man ngag sgra mi snyan gyi tshe dbang thob/ /phyag na rdo rje dregs pa kun 'dul gyi/ /dbang dang rig 'dzin drag sngags gling ba yi/ /rta mgrin dbal chu'i dbang dang seng gdong ma'i/ /dbang thob mthong ba don ldan nas bzung ste/ /sbyor drug khrid lung yongs su rdzogs pa dang/ /jo phur dum gcig khrid lung 'ba' mda' yi/ /dus 'khor khrid dang dngos grub nyer 'tsho'i khrid/ /zab lam nai gu chos drug chen mo yi/ /khrid yig zab don thang mar brdal ba dang / /gzhan yang bde mchog lha lnga gtso 'dus sogs/ /ni gu chos drug gtor ma brgya rtsa'i khrid/ /blo spyong mtshon cha 'khor lo dge bshes kyis/ /gsungs pa'i grub mtha'i rnam bshad lung sogs gsan/ /dgung lo nyer bdun steng la son pa'i tshe/ /kun mkhyen dol po'i rnam 'phrul skyabs mgon rje/ /sbyangs ba bla ma'i gzigs snang dag pa'i ngor/ /35

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /rigs ldan byin rlabs mdzad pa'i gnas mchog che/ /pha ri'i gung thang sgrub khang chen mo sa /sman bla dkon 'phel ka thog byang rdor dang / /bla ma chos 'phags sogs dang lhan cig tu/ /sgrub pa nyams bzhes mdzad skabs thog ma n+da/ /theg chen lam gyi rtsa ba rang gzhan kun/ /srid zhi'i 'jigs pa che las sgrol phyir du/ /bslu med dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsum po/ /sgog gi phyir du mi gtong skyabs su 'dzin/ /gzhan phan lhag bsam kun gsal sgeg mo'i stor/ /snying rje'i chu 'dzin stug po rab 'khrigs pas/ /phan bde'i gru char 'jo ba'i yid can gyi/ /zhing sar dge ba'i ldon bzang rab bskrun pa/ /phun tshogs bye bas sa gsum 'gengs byed pa'i/ /don gnyis 'bras bu'i dpal gyis yongs su brdzid/ /dgung lo nyer brgyad slar yang sgrub grwar bzhugs/ /mi g.yo gsum ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor gyis/ /36

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /ma dag rtsa thig rlung gsum dbu mar dag /mi rtogs ye shes dri bral nam mkha'i khams/ /rnam kun mchog ldan gzugs bzang phra phab mtshungs/ /ji bzhin nyer zhugs mchog gi rnal 'byor gang / /'khor lo drug po'i gnas kun mi 'gyur ba'i/ /bde ba'i gtams shing rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar/ /nye bar bgrod de 'bor 'das dwangs ma'i bas/ /srid gsum gzugs kyi rnam rol sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /dus kun cir yang ngom pa rgyun chad bral/ /dgung lo nyer dgur son pa'i dus skabs su/ /byang sems mchog mnga' sman bla dkon mchog 'phel/ /sgrub brgyud gong ma'i gnas mchog khang dmar du/ /rdo rje slob dpon chen por mnga' gsol tshe/ /bla ma khong dang ka thog byang rdor sogs/ /bla ma bdun tsam lhan cig khang dmar du/ /rgyud sder bzhugs skabs khong gis mchod dpon byas/ /rgyud sde'i blos bslangs dkyil 'khor phyogs bzhi nas/ /37

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /brtson pa lhod med phyi nang mchod rdzas sogs/ /legs par bshams te rgyud sder 'e1 gcig bzhugs/ /dgung lo sum cu'i steng slebs glang chen gyi/ /ri khrod nges don e waṃ dga' tshal du/ /sbyangs ba ma 'das mchog sprul rin po che'i/ /mdun du khong dang ka thog byang rdor dang / /bla ma chos 'grub sogs kyis dpal sprul gyi/ /sngon 'gro'i dpe khrid zla ba gsum tsam la /legs par zhus te mthar phyin 'di skor la/ /kun mkhyen bla ma sbyangs ba rin po ches/ /chos rje grwa tshang yongs la rdul tshon steng / /dus 'khor dbang chen bskur dang spyor drug gi /khrid lung cha tshang jo nang lam rim dang / /'ba' mda'i lam rim nyid kyis gsungs pa yi/ /zhal gdams bde stong nyi zla'i 'od 'phreng dang / /gre bo'i sdom gsum bla ma'i rnal 'byor mchog /gong dang bar ma maṇ+ḍal sogs kyi khrid/ /38

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /mngon pa mdzod kyi 'bru 'grel khrid lung dang / /thugs mchog rdo rje nas gsungs phung lnga'i khrid/ /thun mtshams nyer mkho gdugs dkar mchog sgrub ma'i/ /khrid lung la sogs gang dgos legs par gsan/ /dgung lo so gcig sbyangs ba rin po ches/ /grwa tshang yongs la rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi/ /dbang dang spyong rgyud bcu gnyis ma lus dbang / /grub thob brgyad cu'i rjes gnang ni gu bka'/ /phyi nang yongs rdzogs dbang dang gtor chog ltar/ /yi dam dang bcas chos skyong cha tshang gi /rjes gnang gcod dbang nam mkha' sgo 'byed dang / /phur ba'i stod las byang chub lam 'dren dang / /smad las drag po bsgral dbang dkar bdud kyi/ /rjes gnang dang bcas cha tshang legs par gsan/ /tshe dbang lha gcig bum gcig rjes gnang dang / /rta phyag khyung gsum sbyangs ba'i bsdus grwa dang / /'jam mgon 'ba' mda' bla ma'i lam rim dang / /39

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /dge bshes sbyo/ba mtha' sku gas la gsan sbyangs byas/ /dgung lo so gnyis bskal ba rta yi lor/ /zla ba drug pa'i tshes bas phyi dro'i char/ /mkhan po sbyangs ba mchog sprul rin po che/ /bla ma legs byams slob dpon ming gsol kyang / /ma 'das nyid kyis mkhan slob sbrags ma mdzad/ /gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon dbon dam pa/ /yon tan rgya mtshos mdzad cing las gral ba/ /bla ma skal ldan bstan dar la sogs dang / /dus go ba de bla ma sher blos byas/ /dge 'dun grangs tshang mdun nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi/ /sdom pa legs par nod de khong la mtshan/ /kun dga' tshul khrims rgya mtsho dpal bzang gsol/ /dgung lo so gsum steng la son tsam la/ /sbyangs ba ma 'das mchog sprul rin po che/ /kun dga' blo gros dpal gyi snying po yis/ /rje btsun tā ra nā tha gang nyid kyi/ /40

rnam thar grubaganyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /legs bshad gsung 'bum spar shing brko ba'i mgo/bzung ste sde dge ba dang skya pas sogs/ /spar rko mang po bsdus nas de rnams la/ /khong gis gnyer ba ja ma lo gsum mdzad/ /dgung lo so bzhir sbyangs sprul rin po che'i/ /mdun nas sor mdo tshul khrims rnam dag mdo/ /zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor lung rnams gsan/ /sbyangs ba bla ma'i bla rnams gang thugs ma/ /rgyal bstan ma dang bkra shis brgyad pa dang/ /sku lnga'i gsol mchod nyid kyi gsungs pa yi/ /gser skyems bsdus pa bar do'i ngo sprod dang / /bod yul bde ba'i smon lam skyabs gnas ma/ /zab mdo'i bsrung bzlog bsad gsum gdugs dkar gyi/ /dmigs rim zab mo gdugs chung dang bcas pa/ /rgyud sde bzhi 'brel sgrol ma'i 'don tshogs dang / /sgrol dkar tshe sgrub khrid yig dang bcas pa/ /rgyud bla thar mdo'i lung dang bsnyung gnas kyi/ /41

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /cho ga thar ba'i them skes paṇa chen gyis/ /gsungs pa bsngo dang bsnyung gnas cho ga yang / /lo chen gyis mdzad rigs pa'i khu byug gis/ /mdzad pa'i 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi bstod pa mchog /shes bya'i mkha' dbyings sogs kyi lung rnams gsan/ /dgung lo so lnga'i dus kyi bya ba la/ /bla ma chos 'phags ka thog byang rdor lhan/ /khong rnams sbyangs ba ma 'das rin po che'i/ /mdun du dus 'khor yongs rdzogs khrid zhus nas/ /khong gis chos 'grub byang rdor gnyis po la/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor thig rtsa dang / /lha gnas sgom tshul bcas pa rim bzhin du/ /legs par gsungs nas khong rnams glang chen gyi/ /ri khrod nyid du dus 'khor yongs rdzogs la/ /lhan du bzhugs nas thun bzhir zab mo'i ngang / /yongs rdzogs bskyed rim legs par mthar phyin mdzad/ /dgung lo so drug steng du son pa'i tshe/ /42

rnam thar grub gnyisa'aro ba'i bum bzang /drung ba'i yongs 'dzin bla ma legs byams kyi//mdun nas rgyud sde rab 'byams dbang cha tshang / /gsan nas byang chub lam gyi sgron ma dang / /sgrol ma myur mgyogs rgyal ba kun gyi ma/ /tsaṇ+ḍa go ma'i gsungs rnams legs par gsan/ /sbyangs ba ma 'das mchog sprul rin po ches/ /chos rje ser sde grwa tshang yongs rdzogs la/ /rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dkyil lubor zhe lnga'i dbang / /dus 'khor dbang chen lha dgu'i dbang rnams bskur/ /dus 'khor lhan skyes thams cad rig pa'i dbang / /rdo rje mi 'brugs pa yi dbang rnams thob/ /rdor shugs 'jigs byed khyung khra rta mgrin dang / /'byung 'dul gnyan sgrol thugs rjes chen po'i dbang / /'jam dpal na ga raka mgon po gur/ /drakad rnam sras mkha' 'gro sde lnga dang / /tshe ring mched lnga sogs kyi rjes gnang gsan/ /dgung lo so 'dun steng son chos rje yi/ /43

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /sku dbon dam pa rdo rje 'chang r+sā po/ /kun dga' yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas/ /dus 'khor lha dgu'i dbang bskur zur ming ba'i /gsung gi 'tshams sbyar steng nas legs par thob/ /tshe dbang lha gcig bum gcig rjes gnang dang / /mkhas dbang rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog gis/ /mdzad pa'i jo nang khrid brgya'i rgyud 'debs dang / /brgyud pa'i mtshan sdom khrid brgya'i lo rgyus dang / /khrid brgya'i spyi chings khrid brgya'i sngon 'gro gnyis/ /zhen pa bzhi bral khrid tshul brgya dang brgyad/ /khrid brgya'i 'grel ba ya mtshan 'phrul lde mig /mgon brgya'i mtshan tho dbang brgya'i mtshan tho dang / /smon lam rin chen sna bdun dpe dbang ma/ /bka' dbang bkra shis dang bcas lung khrid thob/ /tā ra nā tha'i 'phros don khrid lung gi /tshul du lan gsum bklag pa'i srol rgyun yod/ /rgyud bla'i 'grel ba seṅge'i nga ro zhes/ /44

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /kong sprul gsung dang spyod 'jug bar do yi/ /ngo sprod smon lam chos grags dpal gyi gsung / /tshogs chos bden bzhi gsal ba kun mkhyen gyis/ /legs gsung blo spyong snyan brgyud chen mo yang / /dngul chu thogs med kyis mdzad don bdun ma/ /slob ma dpal ye ba zhes zin bris ltar/ /dge bsnyen sdom lung lcang skyas mdzad pa dang / /jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha yi/ /bsngags pa ngo mtshar mtha' yas kong sprul gsung / /zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor la brten pa'i/ /tshogs mchod mdor bsdus mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i gsung / /tā ra nā tha'i zhabrungs rabs gsol 'debs dang / /smon lam blo bzang bstan pa rgyal mtsho'i gsung / /de dag lung rnams thob cing khyad par du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa tā ra nā tha yi/ /legs bshad nor bu'i bang mdzod gsung 'bum yang / /rtag brtan spar ltar po ti bco brgyad dang / /45

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /'thor bu po ti bzhi lhag lung rnams thob/ /dgung lo so brgyad steng la rgya dmag thon/ /thams cad phyogs kun bros dgos byung ba'i tshe/ /sbyangs ba ma 'das mchog sprul rin po che/ /gar byon rtsar bcad phyug shul ri khrod la/ /yod zer nga rang de ru 'gro dgongs nas/ /kha zas cung zad khur nas sde'i nang la/ /thon tshe brag phug zhig yod de ru yang / /zhag 'gar bzhugs nas ri khrod 'byor ba'i tshe/ /bla ma rnam gnyis mdun pa jo mo la /thug tshe su yin ci la 'ong zer bas / /nga rang dgra bla'i rga la ku nas yin/ /bla ma gnyis dang der bzhugs mgron po yi/ /mdun la 'ong zhes jo mos de ltar zhus/ /nang du shog gsung bla sprul rnams kyis kyang / /thugs dgyes ngang nas gsung gleng mdzad bzhin du/ /bdag gis 'dzam thang phyogs kyi dmag 'khrug gi /46

rnam thar grub gnyis 'ardzo ba'i bum bzang /lo rgyus ji bzhin zhus tshe mchog sprul gyis/ /khyod rang zhag 'ga' 'di ru sdod cig dang / /bla ma rnam gnyis snying ma'i chos skor re/ /gnang rgyu yin pas nyon gsung legs so zhus/ /rdzogs pa chen po mngon sum rtogs pa yi/ /bya bral bla ma mthu dpal rgya mtsho dang / /'jigs med ye shes zung gi zhal snga nas/ /snying thig sngon 'gro'i blo ldog rnam bzhi nas/ /bla rgyud skyabs sems yig brgya bla rnam dang / /maṇ+ḍal gcod sogs khrid dang dngos gzhi yi/ /sems tshol nas bzung ka dag khregs chod bar/ /nyin mang gsan nas phyir 'ong sde'i mda' yi/ /brag phug nang du bzhugs tshe phyis su yang / /'dug skal e ldan snyam nas 'dzam thang phebs/ /de nas bzung ste khong gi zhabs rkang yang / /basmung tshul bstan nas mi dmangs mnyam las kyi/ /las ka la sogs gang du 'gro ma dgos/ /47

rnam thar grub gnyisau'ajo ba'i bum bzang /dgung lo so dgur ma 'das mchog sprul sogs/ /bla sprul thams cad rim par na mda' dang / /rka mda' 'bar khams sogs la khyer te song / /shul mi bla ser dpon blon rnams la yang / /zhwa nag bskon nas chos byar ma ster tshe/ /a paṃ gter chen rdo rje'i brda lung las/ /phyogs dang nub kyi cha nas su:brgyud pa skyes chen 'ga' yis 'dzin kun mkhyen bstan pa gsal bar byed slar yang sham bha la ru 'gro zhes pa'i lung bstan ji bzhin khong gis kyang / /sbyangs ba'i rgyal tshab byas te lo gsar skabs/ /smon lam sgrol ma sa zla'i dus mchod dang / /dbyar gnas drug mchod sbyangs ba'i bskang gsol sogs/ /nyin mtshan gang bder brtson pa drag po'i sgos/ /rgyun ma chad par byas nas 'di skor la/ /skyabs rje mgo ba bla ma bstan dar gyis/ /48

rnam tharashābaganyisa'ajo ba'i bumobazang /mdun nasasor mdo tshul khrims rnam dag mdo/ /thar bsdus blo spyong mtshon 'khor lung rnams gsan/ /dgung lo bzhi bcu'i steng la bslab gsum gyi/ /rgyan 'chang kun dga' rin chen rdo rje yi/ /zhal nas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po che/ /kun mkhyen she rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang gis/ /mdzad pa'i rdzogs ldan bstan pa'i dgongs 'grel mchog /po ti drug gi lung yang dbon dam pa/ /yon to rgya mtsho thob yig ji lta bar/ /legs par thob cing slar yang sngar ltar du/ /lo gsar sgrol ma nas bzung bskang gsol bar/ /thams cad chad du ma bcug mchog sprul gyi/ /gsung 'phrin 'byor ba'i skyes lan khong nyid kyi/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus mchog sprul rin po che/ /nyid kyi 'tshams rtags yi ge legs par 'phrod/ /da lan bdag gis kun btus rtsa 'grel dang / /yi ge 'ga' re bskur yod de nas yang / /49

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /rim bzhin bskur nges nyid la zhabs brtan du/ /rang gis mgo 'dzin bka' chos dag tshar dang / /smyung gnas sum brgya tsam dang tshe bsnyen dung / /ma ṇi dung phyur ha k+ṣa dung phyur dang / / /tshe thar sum brgya tsam dang yig brgya dang / /mdo gdugs sgrol gsum maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa sogs/ /mang tsam grub zin gzhan yang lo gnyis kyi/ /ring la dbyar gnas sa zla drug mchod dang / /lo gsar sgrol ma sbyangs ba'i bskang gsol sogs/ /ma 'chags tsam byas kun mkhyen gsung 'bum dang / /rje btsun gsung 'bum lung rnams bdag gis zhus/ /thams chad nyid kyi zhabs pad brtan phyir du/ /ma dmigs pa ni gcig kyang yod ma yin/ /da dung zhabs brtan dngos rdzas ci dgos rnams/ /yi ge bskur dang nges par sgrub pa yin/ /nyid kyi thugs bskyed ma zhan bzhugs pa ni/ /bka' drin shin tu che zhus lan du yang / /50

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /ma 'das mchog sprul gang gi zhal snga nas/ /dad dang tshul khrims gtong la goms pa dang / /thos pa'i rgyud grol khrel yod ngo tsha shes/ /shes rab phun sum tshogs pa'i nor ldan drung / /zhu ba nyid kyi gnas tshul mdzad spyod rnams/ /zhib mo bdag gis thos pas dga' spro che/ /khyod kyis bdag gi khur blangs 'di ltar du/ /bsgrub pa las lhag bdag gi sgog 'tsho thabs/ /gzhan med rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la/ /phan nges bya rgyu gzhan med drin che zhing / /rang cag 'phrad pa'i rten 'brel gos dar dang / /rgyal ba tshe dpag med kyi sku brtan zhig /khyed la phul bas nyid sku yun ring du/ /'chi med rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob nges pa'i/ /smon 'dun legs phyogs yod pas bdag gir bzhes/ /bya ba gang bsgrub shin tu gsang bar zhu/ /dgung lo zhe gcig la yang sgrol ma dang / /51

rnam thar grub gnyispo'ajo ba'i bum bzang /sa zla dbyar gnas drug mchod chen mo sogs/ /dus yun zhag ma lnga drug tsam re la /ma chag par byas de skabs sgrig lam yang / /shin tu dam pas phyogs kyi dgon pa dang / /yul mi rnams las sku gsung thugs rten rnams/ /thams cad 'phrog bcom byas te phyogs gcig tu/ /bsdus nas tha na yig ldeb gcig tsam dang / /phreng ba rdog gcig rig mi chog pa'i skabs/ /khong gis hur brtson pa dang byis pa dang / / yul mi su yi lag nas gang rnyed kyi/ /sku gsung thugs rten mchod cha du ma dang / /tha na gdung shun pa tra gcig yan chad/ /sgor mo rtsam pa gang dgos ster nas nyos/ /khong gis sto gos ngan ngon tsam gyis kyang / /chog shes bsten te phyi'i 'byung thugs la mnga'/ /nam mkha' mtsho dang nyid kyi nu bo sogs/ /nyid la sha tsha byed pa'i mi rnams kyis/ /52

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /khyod kyi sku gsung thugs rten tshogs pa rnams/ /bar skabs re zhig zhog dang bzang zer kyang / /khong gis zhal nas 'o ya skyon med gsungs/ /dgung lo zhe gnyis la yang sngar ltar byas/ /chos lugs sogs la shin tu rtsub pa'i rkyen/ /nu bo sogs kyis khyod la byed rgyu mang / /'di ltar dus mchod ma dgos kha 'gul na/ /brdung rdeg byed kyin yod pa ma tshor ram/ /zhus tshe bla mas zhal rtsed tshul du yang / /khang babs nas las la ma sdig dang / /khang rgyab nyi ma dro nyin yod/ /zhes gsung sgrol ma sa zla dbyar gnas dang / /drug mchod sbyangs ba'i bskang gsol lo re bzhin/ /shin tu gsang ba'i sgo nas chag med byas/ /khong dang dbon po yon to rgya mtsho dang / /bla ser rnams kyis mgo 'dren byasanas su/ /sbyangs ba rin po che yi zhabs brtan dang / /53

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /spyi bsrung mnyam du mtshams dang mtshams su 'don/ /sbyangs ba tshang la yi ge 'tshams rtagasadang / /bzhugs zhu lan mang bskur tshe yar la yang / /yi ge mang thon da lta re zung las/ /'bri rgyu ma rnyed skor gcig 'di ltar du/ /tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pa'i/ /bsgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes pa'i khrims ldan dpal bzang gang drung du/ /zhu ba nyid bde ngos nas bdag gi yang / /'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen legs sgrub pa/ /bka' drin che zhu ched don a paṃ gis/ /lung bstan 'phros don ji bzhin tshe sngon yang / /sham bha la nas 'dir 'ong bar chad med/ /slar yang sham bha la ru 'gro bar gsungs / /rang cag mnyam du 'gro ba'i re smon bcas/ /yang yang bslu med rin chen rnam gsum la/ /skyabs 'jug bcas pa'i zhu ba 'dir yang ni/ /54

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /yi ge yar mar bskyal sogs rnying lugs rnams/ /gsar 'gyur mi 'phrod shin tu gsang bar zhu/ /bdag gi mngar chas re dang 'bras rgya ma/ /lnga sogs byis pa 'brid byed lta bu dang / /rten 'dus legs pa dang bcas gang bskur rnams/ /dbon po yon tan rgya mtsho legs byams dang / /rin chen rdo rje chos 'phel byams pa dang / /chos dpal gsal byed yig bdag la sogs pa/ /khyed la grogs byed gnang dang nu bo sogs/ /kun la me tog chung yang mchod pa'i rdzas/ /yon chab nyung ba rgya mtsho'i phud lta bu/ /rten 'brel legs pa'i phyogs bsgrig tshe bum gyi/ /tshe rdzas sngon gyi rgyal ba paṇa chen dang / /dbus gtsang bla ma rnams nas gnang ba dang / /a mchog rin po che dang mchog rtse yi/ /gser khri rnams dang rgyal bo yab sras kyi/ /phyag tu 'ong ba snga phyi kun bsdus pa'i/ /55

rnam thar grub gnyimo'ajo ba'i bum bzang /ngo bo 'chi med tshe lha rnam gsum las/ /tshe ril tshe chang dam rdzas sman bcas yin/ /kun gyis gsol bar zhu zhes phyag 'phrin 'byor/ /de'i dgun zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu la/ /sbyangs ba ma 'das mchog sprul rin po che/ /ngo mtshar du masaltas dang bcas pa yi/ /gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos sku'i dbyings su bsdus/ /de tshe sgrig lam shin tu dam na yang / /khong gis mgo 'dren byas te bla ser rnams/ /lkog tu bsdusate gdung mchod gang 'dzoms byas/ /dgung lo zhe gsum dus su sgrol ma sogs/ / dus mchod sgrig lam dam pas bla ser rnams/ /nyin mor las byed song yang mtshan mor 'tshogs/ /de skabs shin tu gsang bas dbon dam pa/ /kun dga' yon tan rgya mtsho'i mdun drung du/ /jo nang chos grags dpal gyis gsungs pa yi/ /ma dros klu yi char chog ldeb shar bcas/ /56

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /gnas chung rgyal po sku lnga'i gsol kha yang / /bstan srung dgyes pa'i mchod sprin zhes pa dang / /kun mkhyen rin po che yi rnam thar yang / /dge legs nor phreng ma ṇi ka shrī gsungs/ /yab sras bco lnga'i rnam thar jo bzang gsung / /rus chog sī tsha gdab pa'i cho ga yang / /srid mtsho las sgrol gru chen dge bshes gsung / /blo spyong don bdun dngul chu thogs med gsung / /kong sprul gsungs pa'i blo sbyong don bdun ma/ /blo sbyong brgyud 'debs smon lam chen mo dang / /blo spyong tshig brgyad glang ru thang ba'i gsung / /kun rig mtshams sbyar chen mo warta ya/ /mtshams sbyar chung ba rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i/ /mtshamasasbyar 'jam dbyangasabastan 'dzin bzang bo'igasung / /ngo sprod smon lam chos grags dpal gyi gsung / /tshul khrims rnam dag 'pho ba thar lam ma/ /bar do'i chos bshad rgyas bsdus dge bshes gsung / /57

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyi rtsa bskyed dang / /bar do'i ngo sprod gtsug lag phreng bas gsung / /kame bi dzis gsungs ba'i ngo sprod dang / /rgyud 'bras dbu ma'i thig le'i 'bru 'grel yang / /gnad don gsal byed zhes pa dge bshes gsung / /sman bla mdo chog grags pa don 'grub kyis/ /cho bsgrigs sman chung paṇa chen chos rgyan gsung / /snang srid zhi ba gu ru chos dbang gsung / /rat+na ma tis gsungs ba'i gzungs 'bul gyi/ /cho ga shel dkar me long de'i bdag bskyed/ /snying po kye rdor nam mkha' dpal bzang gsung / /'phags yul grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi la/ /mchod cing gsol ba btab pa'i cho ga yang / /dngos grub kun 'byung 'jam mgon kong sprul gsung / /sgrol ma maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga yang / /grub ljon zhes pa tshe dbang nor bu'i gsung / /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsungs pa yi /58

rnam thar grub gnyir+sā'ajo ba'i bum bzang /maṇ+ḍal cho ga bkra shis char 'bebs dang / /thugs dam gnad bskul rat+na gling ba yi/ /zab gter mtsho rgyal skor gsum nang sgrub las/ /sgrol ma'i cho ga kong sprul chog bsgrigs dang / /gzhi gsum lag len rnam gsal sgron me zhes/ /kong sprul gsung dang dge slong sdom rgyun gyi/ /gsol 'debs ye shes rgya mtshos mdzad pa dang / /dpal chen mo yi g.yang sgrub cha lag bcas/ /dus 'khor rnying ba dang ni sangs rgyas kyi/ /mdun bskyod gnas mdo bde chen snying po'i gsung / /dkon mchog spyi 'dus las byung rig 'dzin mchog /'ja' tshon snying po'i gter kha cha lag bcas/ /tshe g.yang 'gugs pa 'dod dgu'i dpal ster yang / /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang pos mdzad pa dang / /sor mdo skang gsar cha tshang rta mgrin gyi/ /gto pod cha tshang phur ba cha tshang gsan/ /sman pa bla ma kun dga' dkon 'phel gyi/ /59

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /mdun nas spyod 'jug sa bzang 'grel ba yang / /dgongs pa rab gsal snang ba'i khrid lung dang / /tshul khrims rnam dag sor mdo'i lung sogs thob/ /dgung lo zhe bzhir son pa'i dus skabs su/ /sngar bzhin lo gsar sgrol ma'i sgrub mchod dang / /sa zla'i dus mchod dbyar gnas la sogs pa/ /dusamachod rim bzhin ma chad tsam re byas/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed 'bru non snyan brgyud kyi/ /bsnyen mtshams kha skong dang bcas legs par bzhugs/ /dgung lo zhe lnga la yang sgrol ma dang / /sa zla dbyar gnas drug mchod la sogs pa/ /sngar ltar gsang ba'i sgo nas rim bzhin 'tshogs/ /bslu med mchog gsum bden mthus 'tshe ma byung / /chos sku kun khyab mkha' klong dwangasama'i gzhir/ /gzugs sku mtshan dpe'i 'od stong rtse dga' yis/ /yid mtshor snang brtan 'bum dkrigs dge mtshan las/ /sa gsum shis pas 'gengs ba'i ngo mtshar med/ /60

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /dgung lo zhe drug steng du dus mchod rnams/ /sngar bzhin 'tshogs nas sgrub thabs rin 'byung yang / /rgya nag ye shes rdo rjes bkrol ba yi/ /zangs par yi ge pod bzhi rgyasabasregs pa'i/ /'phro rnams slar gso byas te khong la yang / /dbang lung sngar ma thob cing phyis su yang / /dbang rgyud spel ched rim gnyis rnal 'byor ba/ /blo bzang dpal ldan bstan 'dzin snyan grags kyi/ /mdun nas grub chen nyi ma sbas pa yi/ /lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig gtsor mdzad pas/ /rjes gnang nyis brgya lhag tsam legs par gsan/ /phyis su grwa tshang spyi la rin 'byung gi /dbang gnang skabs su khong la ma thob rnams/ /grub bsnyes bla ma chos 'phags la zhus te/ /rjes gnang sum brgya lhag bcas rdzogs par gsan/ /dgung lo zhe bdun steng la slebs pa'i dus/ /dam pa gong ma'i phyag srol ji bzhin du/ /61

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /slar yang sgrol ma nas bzung sa zla dang / /dbyar gnas drug mchod rnams ni sngar las/ /zhag grangs cung mang ba re 'tshogs skabs ldan/ /de nas sku gdung 'thor bu sogs nyos nas/ /mgar ba 'ga' red zhig gso byed du bcug /yi ge dpe dkon 'ga' re yig bzo ba/ /kame nor bu sogs la 'brir bcug go /dgung lo zhe brgyad dus kyi bya ba yang / /rgyal bstan mi nub dar rgyas 'gro ba dang / /sems can bde skyid 'phel kha rgyas phyir du/ /khong gis mi dman thugs bskyed lhod med kyis/ /sgrol ma sa zla dbyar gnas drug mchod sogs/ /dus mchod rim par 'tshogs pa chad ma bcug /dusa'akhor yongasardzogasabasnyen mtshamasabazhugasaskabasasu/ /rgya la 'jigs tshe lha dgu'i sgrub thabs kyi/ /gtsor byas bsnyen tshad kha bskang bcas pa grub/ /dgung lo zhe dgur dus mchod chad ma bcug /62

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /rdzo nang yab sras rnams kyi rnam thar dang / /khrid yig mthong ba don ldan la sogs pa/ /sbyor drug chos skor ni gu chos skor dang / /rdzo nang lam rim dpe dkon du ma dang / /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos sbyangs ba rin po che/ /ma 'das kun dga' dpal gyi snying po yis/ /legs gsung rnam grangs mdo slob 'grel ba dang / /rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa yi khrid yig dang / /bsdus grwa sbyangs ba'i rnam thar zhal gdams kyang / /nyi zla'i 'od phreng la sogs gsung 'bum gyi/ /po ti lnga sogs yi ge du ma yang / /bris te khong gis yon sogs mi dman byas/ /dgung grangs lnga bcur son pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /sgrol ma nas bzung dus mchod legs par 'tshogs/ /mi dmangs mnyam las dus khag re res kyang / / ser srung ser mo gnyis gnyis bzhag yod par/ /de rnams ser srung man ngag rdo rje mchu/ /63

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ardzo ba'i bum bzang /rdo rje rgya can la sogs zhag gsum tsam/ /bsgrubs te ser tho bkram pa'i bar dang yang / /ser srung rnams la bskyed rim sna re yi/ /khrid dang bcas te bsnyen mtshams 'dug tu bcug /dgung lo nga gcig steng du dus mchod rnams/ /rim par 'tshogs te bstan 'gro'i dpal du bzhugs/ /sngon chad dbon po yon to rgya mtsho yis/ /khrid yig 'dus gsal tshang ba'i khrid dmigs dang / /mgon po brag rdzong ma yi man ngag rnams/ /mtha' dag gnang ba ltar du lo der yang / /mgon po brag rdzong ma yi bsnyen mtshams te/ /kha bskang dang bcas ji bzhin 'grub par byas/ /dgung lo nga gnyis skor la sngar bzhin du/ /sgrol ma nas bzung jo nang drug mchod bar/ /thams cad sngar ltar rim bzhin legs par 'tshogs/ /grwa tshang spyi la mkho ba'i yo byad la/ /da lta grags can dpal rdzong rol mo dang / /64

rnam thar grab gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /mchod cha mchod rdzas la sogs ji snyed nyos/ /thams cad chos rje grwa tshang spyi la bzhag /mchod cha gang bzang yod bla ma'i drin/ /dgung lo nga gsum skor la sgrol ma dang / /sa zla drug mchod la sogs legs par bsgrubs/ /mgar ba du ma bsdus te khong gis kyang / /dngul gyi mchod rten mgar du bcug pa'i tshe/ /mgar ba rnams la thang stong rgyal po yi/ /rnam thar gsungs nas khyed tshos khong nyid la/ /byi ru'i chod rten zhig ni bzo dgos gsungs/ /nged tshos mi shes zhus tshe khong gis bslabs/ /ngo mtshar byi ru'i mchod rten khru gang dang / /mdzub gang yod pa bzhengs te mgar ba rnams/ /gla dang ston mo'i dga' ston legs par grub/ /dgung lo nga bzhir dus mchod sngar bzhin 'tshogs/ /nges don bsgrub brgyud bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mchog /sbyangs ba ma 'das gang gi sku gdung yang / /65

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /byang chub rten mchog gser gdung bzhengs ba'i tshe/ /ngo mtshar gter rdol ji bzhin sngar med pa'i/ /gser dngul g.yu byir rin chen sna tshogs rted/ /khong gis mgo 'dren mdzad de grwa tshang spyis/ /khur blangs shing bzo dngul bzo la sogs pa/ /ci dgos legs par 'byor bas mthar grub bo/ /dgung lo nga lnga'i skor la sgrol ma dang / /sa zla dbyar gnas la sogs drug mchod rnams/ /sngar las cung zad rgyas pa 'tshogs skabs ldan/ /mgo khrid sogs kyis grogs bcas mgar ba rnams/ /bsdus te rim bzhin dngul gyi mchod rten yang / /cha brgyad phran bcas mtho gang las lhag tsam/ /yod pa bzhengs te mgar ba rnams la yang / /gla dang ston mo la sogs legs par grub/ /dgung lo nga drug steng la slebs pa'i dus/ /sgrol ma la sogs dus mchod sngar bzhin byas/ /lha mi'i zhing gi bsod nams rten gyi mchog /66

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rten sna tshogs yang / /dngul zangs las bskrun mchod rten khru do tsam/ /yod pa gcig dang ma 'das gang nyid kyi/ /sku gdung cha brgyad mi yi lus tshad tsam/ /yod pa slob ma re res bzhengs mgo bzung / /dgung lo nga bdun dus mchod rim par bsgrub/ /sbyangs ba'i sku gdung cha brgyad dag las kyang / /khong gis gser dngul las bskrun sgrib sel gyi/ /mchod rten bzhengs te g.yu byir rin chen sogs/ /phra rgyan mgar ba rnams kyis bsgrigs pa'i tshe/ /che ba gcig gis ma 'dang phyi nyin du/ /khong gis rin chen gru bzhi g.yu lta bu'i/ /ngo bo brjod mi shes pa zhig rnyed pas/ /mgar ba rnams ni ngo mtshar ha las te/ /'di nyid gter nas blangs ltar gang nas rnyed/ /zhes brjod rin chen seng khri'i dbus su bzhag /dgung lo nga brgyad steng du dus mchod rnams/ /67

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /sngar ltar dbyar gnas pa yang nyi shu tsam/ /mkhas grub gnyis ldan bla ma blo ldan gyis/ /dbyar gnas mkhan po mdzad de sdom gsum gyi/ /khrid lung la sogs chos khrid sna tshogs byas/ /shing gi sgrol ma'i mchod rten khru gang zhig /khong gis phyag bzo byas te de'i rjes su/ /rje dbon yon tan rgya mtsho'i sku gdung yang / /gser dngul las byas sgrol ma'i mchod rten zhig /g.yu byir rin chen spos shel la sogs pa/ /phra rgyan brgya phrag lhag yod spus legs shing / /mdzes brdzid ldan pa thog tshad nye ba zhig /bzhengs te gla ston la sogs legs par grub/ /dgung lo nga dgur dus mchod sngar ltar las/ /dbyar gnas nyi shu lhag la mkhan po yang / /nyid kyis mdzad de dge tshul dge slong gi /sdom pa gnang nas lo de'i ston dgun mtshams/ /sbyangs ba'i sku gdung mthong grol chen mo rtswa /68

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /rab gnas 'tshogs tshe sku gdung mdun nyid du/ /rab gnas cho ga 'gro phan rgyas byed kyi/ /sgo nas slob dpon bla ma khong nyid dang / /bla ma blo ldan rnam gnyis re mos byas/ /skyabs rje bla ma chos 'phags gang nyid kyis/ /khri ba byas te bde mchog dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bde ba chen po'i char yang zhes pa la/ /rab gnas btags te rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /dbon po 'jigs med rgya mtsho nyin rer byon/ /gtsang ba'i rdo rje slob dpon chen po gang / /ngag dbang yon tan bzang po nyin gsum la/ /byon te dge 'dun du mas rab gnas byas/ /dgung grangs drug cu tham par son pa'i skabs/ /lo gsar sgrol ma la sogs sngar bzhin las/ /sa zla'i dus mchod yar tshes bco lnga la/ /sbyangs ba ma 'das yang sprul rin po che/ /kun dga' shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ /69

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khri la bkod nas su/ /khong gis yas gtam dge legs dpal 'bar gyi/ /zhu mchod phul nas mchog sprul rin po che/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i spyi gzugs su/ /mnga' gsol sbyangs ba'i dbon po ngag dbang dpal/ /yongs 'dzin bskos te klog sogs legs par bslab/ /nyid kyis sku yon maṇ+ḍal rten tsam la/ /sgrol ma'i gser sku rta dang gos dar phul/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon ོ po mchog /kun dga' bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sku gdung la/ /mgar ba seng bzang skal bzang la sogs pa/ /mgar ba mang po bsdus nas gser dngul gyi/ /mchod rten sku 'bum mthong grol chen mo bzhengs/ /mdzes shing shin tu che ba'i byu ru dang / /gzhan yang g.yu dang spos shel mu min gzi/ /rin chen mu tig phra rgyan mang po dang / /gdung chen steng sogs gser dngul las bzos pa'i/ /70

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /mchod rdzas rtags brgyad 'dod yon rnam lnga dang / /nor bu cha bdun sogs kyis mdzes par brgyan/ /bum ngos rnams su ston pa bzhi ldan gyi/ /sku brnyan zangs gser 'bur du dod pa dang / /pad+ma nyi zla sgra gcan gdan dang bcas/ /nang bzhugs sangs rgyas ring bsrel gsum gyis gtso'i/ /ring bsrel rnam bzhi dri med rnam gnyis dang gzungs 'jug tshad ldan shin tu spus legs shing / /mtho dman thog tshad tsam zhig grub par byas/ /dgung lo re gcig steng du ma 'das kyi/ /yang sprul dge bskor tshang la zhabrungs yod pa/ /sgrol ma skyabs dang sher ko rnam gnyis gtsos/ /thun pa bzhi bcu tsam la dbon dam pa/ /kun dga' 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas/ /sngon 'gro nas bzung rim bzhin spyor drug gi /khrid rnams gnang nas spyor drug la bzhugs skabs/ /mchog sprul shes rab rgyal mtshan gang nyid la/ /71

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /khong gis skyabs 'gro nas bzung rjes khrid bar/ /gsal gdab ngo sprod gegs sel bogs 'don rnams/ /rim bzhin legs par gnang nas 'di skor la/ /grwa tshang spyi la bla ma rin po che/ /khong gis sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas kyi/ /rjes gnang sum brgya lhag dang rgya gar gyi/ /grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i rjesaganang rnams/ /rdzogs par bskur nas lo de'i ston kha mā /ru sde'i nang la khang dmar gser sku dang / /tshogs zangs sogs kyi ched du rgyu bsod byas/ /de ni rgyu bsod byon pa'i thog ma yin/ /dgung lo re gnyis steng la son pa'i tshe/ /mchog sprul shes rab rgyal mtshan la sogs par/ /rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa yi sta gon dang / /dngos gzhi'i dbang dang khrid sogs rdzogs par gnang / /zla ba lnga pa'i nyi shu'i tshes skor la/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po kun spangs ba/ /72

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /blo bzang ngapal ldan bstan 'dzin snyan grags rje/ /dbyar gnas mkhan por bzhugs skabs jo nang pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa tā ra nā tha yi/ /bka' 'bum rdzogs ldan chos mchog gnyis pa'i lung / /thog mar ka pod nas bzungs pa pod bar/ /bcu gsum lung gnang de nas pha pod nas/ /dza pod bar gyi po ti drug po dang / /'thor bu po ti gnyis te brgyad tsam gyi/ /lung gi 'phro rnams bla ma nyid kyi gnang / /dgung lo re gsum sa zla'i nyi shu'i skor/ /gza' skar 'phrod spyor bzang po 'dzoms pa'i dus/ /rigs ldan rnam 'phrul rdo rje slob dpon mchog /kun dga' 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i mdun drung du/ /bla ma khong dang bla sprul du ma dang / /ser mo sum brgya lhag la rdul tshon gyi/ /steng nas dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang zhus tshe/ /slob ma rjes 'dzin sta gon byis 'jug dang / /73

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /mchog dbang gong ma mchog dbang khyad par can/ /bdag po bdag chen dbang rnams legs par gsan / /gzhan yang rdo rje phur ba'i dbang cha tshang / /spyan ras gzigs dang dus 'khor lha dgu'i dbang / /legs par gsan nas de yi mjug thog tu/ /kun dga' 'jigs rgya mtshos mkhan po dang / /bla ma khong gis las kyi slob dpon mdzad/ /las gral dge slong du ma'i mdun nas su/ /mchog sprul shes rab rgyal mtshan gtsos mdzad de/ /bla ser lnga bcu tsam la so thar gyi/ /dge slong dge tshul sdom pa legs par gnang / /dgung lo re bzhir nu bo gshegs song bas/ /dge ba dgongs rdzogs la sogs mthar phyin mdzad/ /de yi dbyar khar ga zla ba'i 'phror/ /bla brang nang du sku rten bzhengs mgo bzung / /'dzi rong lha bzo la sogs mi drug gis/ /mi pham rgyal ba byams pa mgon po yi/ /74

rnam thar grubaganyispo'ajo ba'i bum bzang /sku 'bag thog tshad gnyisapa tsam zhig dang / /g.yas su sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dang / /g.yon du mar me mdzad gnyis thog tshad lhag /nyan thos bzhi dang nye ba'i sras chen brgyad/ /sku brnyan thog tshad yod pa tsam re bzhengs/ /bla ma khong gis lo de'i drug mchod kyi/ /khri ba byas rjes bla brang sku rnams la/ /sbyangs sprul shes rab rgyal mtshan dbur bcas pas/ /bla ser du mas 'gro phan rgyas byed kyi/ /cho ga tshogs nas rab gnas tshad ldan byas/ /dgung lo re lngar son pa'i dus skabs su/ /sngon chad rat+na shri'i bzhengs pa yi /mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang mthong grol yang / /sa dang rdo las bskrun pa'i mgo brtsams te/ /khri bcu'i stag lha la sogs mi mang pos/ /lo der spyan gnas man chad grub par byas/ /bla ma khong gis rgya rar lo de yang / /75

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /ser mo nyi shu tsam la ma 'das kyis/ /gsungs pa'i bsdus grwa zla bcu tsam la khrid/ /rgad po bdag med gur rnam zer ba zhig /nad rkyen theb pas khrus zhur 'ong ba'i tshe/ /khrus mjug bla ma khong gis dbu mdzad byas/ /'pho ba gzab ldan gsungs nas phyi nyin du/ /rgad po shi song bla ma khong gis kyang / /de 'dra mkhyen pa'i rnam grangs du ma mchis/ /dgung lo re drug steng la dbon dam pa/ /kun dga' 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i bkas bskul te/ /pha ri'i sgrub grwa pa rnams khrid dgos gsungs/ /skya phas bla ma chos 'grub la sogs par/ /khrid mgo bzung nas sgrub grwa pa rnams bskyangs/ /sos khar yon bdag rgan mo ri thar ma/ /'chi nad thebs te nga rang ma 'chi gong / /bla ma mjal dgos bsu mar myur song zer/ /dbang chen bla ma bsur 'ong khong gnyis kyang / /76

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /myur byon khang dmar thad la thon pa'i tshe/ /bla ma'i zhal nas ma ṇi gsung bzhin du/ /rta kha 'then te da ltar rang nyid gnyis/ /'gro 'am mi 'gro gsung tshe nga rang gis/ /mgyogs par 'gro zhes yar la thon pa'i tshe/ /rgan mo shi zin bla ma'i thugs la yang / /de 'dra mkhyen nas 'gro'am mi 'gro gsung / /de yi dbyar khar bkra shis sgo mang gi /mchod rten nang la lha bzo 'dzin pa sogs/ /mi brgyad tsam gyis lha sa'i chags tshul bzos/ /lho sgo dbus mar yid bzhin nor bu dang / /mi 'gro gsung 'byon kun mkhyen gangs can mtsho/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang rasne shri dang / /jo nang rje btsun sogs kyi sku brnyan bzhugs/ /g.yas ma'i nang la rang byung lnga ldan dang / /yum chen mo dang g.yon ma'i nang nyid du/ /thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal dang ni/ /77

rnam thar grub sa/nyispo'ajo ba'i bum bzang /byams pa chos 'khor kha sar pa ṇi dang / /ra ma rgya mo sogs bzhugs nub sgo'i dbus/ /rgyal ba 'od dpag med mgon gtso 'khor gsum/ /sa snying kun tu bzang dang sgo g.yas la/ /jo bo lo ki sho ra nye sras gnyis//sgo g.yon nang la gu ru gtso 'khor gsum/ /byang g.yas thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa/ /g.yas sgor sman bla g.yon sgor chos rgyal rje/ /srong btsan sgam po rgya za bal za gsum/ /shar sgo'i dbus mar tshe lha rnam gsum dang / /g.yas sgor mi bskyod pa dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /g.yon sgo'i nang la byams khrus mdzad ma dang / /sgrol ma ljang mo dar len ma yang bzhugs/ /de dag lha sku rnams kyi bar bar du/ /'jim sku kun mkhyen khru gang mang po dang / /gnas bstan bcu drug sogs kyis bar med bkang / /gzhan yang gyang ris lhathog thang mang po bzhugs/ /78

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /nang gzhug gzungs chen 'bum phrag mang po dang / /dri med rnam gnyis dkyil 'khor tshad ldan dang / /ring bsrel grangs mang gser sku grangs mang dang / /byang sems chos 'phags gser sku rgya nag ma/ /rje btsun sgrol ma'i gser sku nyer gcig dang / /kun mkhyen zhabs lham bka' gdam mchod pa'i rten/ /gzhan yang gsung 'bum glegs bam mang po dang / /mchod cha mchod rdzas rigs mang ser skya dang / /bud med gos bcas cha tshang mang po bcas/ /gzungs gzhug tshad ldan dang bcas legs par grub/ /de nas drug mchod skabs su sdom chen la/ /rab gnas cho ga 'gro phan rgyas byed yang / /btags te grwa tshang yongs rdzogs nyin bdun bar/ /sbyin bsregs dang bcas rab gnas rgyas par byas/ /gzhan yang rgyud sde rab 'byams rin 'byung sogs/ /dbang bskur skabs su mchod rten de nyid la/ /gzungs thag bskyangs te dbang bskur brtan bzhugs byas/ /79

rnam thar gruspuganyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /dgung lo re bdun sgrub grwa pa rnams la/ /chos khrid sna tshogs byas rjes sos khar yang / /nam mkha' mtsho shi dgongs zhag legs grub bgyis/ /dbyar kha ru sde'i nang la rgyu bsod phebs/ /rta nor mang po la sogs rnyed pa bzang / /tshong gnyer rdo dpal sangs rgyas dpal sogs bzhag /sngon chad 'jigs med dpal gyi seṅge yis/ /bzhengs pa'i kun thub mchod rten bzhengs mgo brtsams/ /dpal ko sogs kyis khri bcu'i stag lha sogs/ /mi grangs bzhi bcu tsam btsal las mgo bzung/ /de nas sngar bzhengs bkra shis sgo mang gi /bum pa'i nang du dus kyi 'khor lo'i lha/ /drug brgya so drug bzhengs te gser tog btsugs/ /'di skor khong gis grwa tshang spyi la yang /khrid lung gnang ste rta mgrin phur ba dang / /sman bla'i cho ga gshin po rjes 'dzin bcas/ /dus 'khor rnying ba bskang gsol gsar rnying dang / /80

rnam tharazusgeganyispo'ajo ba'i bum bzang /bka' brgyad gu drag seng gdong kun rig dang / /thar mdo thar chog sku lnga dge bshes gsungs/ /sku lnga'i bskang mdos zab tig maṇ+ḍal dang / /phyag 'tshal bstan pa spyi 'grel lung rnams gnang / /dkon mchog rjes dran nas bzung bstan 'bar ma'i/ /bar gyi chos spyod cha lag tshang ma bcas/ /mdo gdugs sgrol gsum kun mkhyen bla sgrub dang / /sbyangs ba'i bla rnam sogs kyi lung rnams gnang / /de yi dgun khar bzhag shod dgon lngar phebs/ /grwa ba stan ko bzod ldan gnyis kyisabyas/ /rang re'i bu dgon rnams la 'tshams rtags dang / /zhal 'debasaganang sbyin cung zad mdzad pa yang / /dza mgo'i ri khrod 'bri gcig sgor sum brgya/ /ya mda'i dgon la sgor mo sum brgya dang / /bzhi bcu sag ra tshang la sgor nyer lnga/ /ya blo'i tshang la sgor mo nyer lnga dang / /pā la dgon par shog dngul sum brgya dang / /81

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /lnga bcu 'bru rigs rgya ma stong phrag gcig /khang sar sgor mo sum brgya lnga bcu dang / /'bri gsum bho waṃ ro'i tshang sgor so lnga/ /sho mda'i mchod rten slar gso byed pa la/ /rta zog che chung nga gcig gro nas yang / /rgya ma stong gcig brgyad brgya sgor stong gcig /brgyad brgya bcu phrag gcig dang rnam bu gsum/ /ba mo gcig dang ka to tshang la yang / /bka' chos blu yon la yang rgod ma gcig /sgor mo brgya dang nga bzhi bkra shis sgang / /rgod ma gcig dang rgor mo lnga bcu bcas/ /de ltar dgon pa rnams la 'tshams rtags phul/ /dgung lo re brgyad steng du sgrub grwa bar/ /sbyor drug la sogs chos khrid sna tshogs byas/ /de yi dpyid khar bla ma sgrub grwa la/ /rgad po khas los bskyal song rgad po yang /slar 'ong khyim la thon tshe 'gam nang nas/ /82

rnam thar grubaganyisa'ajo ba'i busabazang /bzod ldan la sogs mi 'gas bud shing thon/ /bla ma gar bzhugs nged rang thug dgos zer/ /sgrub grwar byon yod khyed rnams ja 'thung rjes/ /der song byas pas de rnams ja 'thung skabs/ /khong nyid rgyun du bzhugs pa'i nang ra nas/ /byon te khyed rnams e dka' gsung bzhin bzhugs/ /de rnams la yang zhal brda zhib rgyasaganang / /rgad po'i khyed nyid ji ltar thon zhus tshe/ /khong gi zhal nas 'u gnyis snga phyi sa /'ong zhes khyod kyis phyi mig ma bltas sam/ /zhes gsungs ci yin snyam nasargad po yang / /pha rir blta ru song nas sgrub grwa bar/ /dris tshe da skabs nged rnams khrid tshar nas/ / gsol ja bzhes te 'tshags la yod zer bas/ /rgad pos bla ma tshur lam bsus nas 'ong / /khong gis nyin gcig sku lus bkod pa gnyis/ /sprul ba de yang zol med bden pa yin/ /83

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /de yi dbyar khar pā la dgon pa yi/ /bla ma mgo 'gon la sogs bla grwa yang / /'ga' zhig thon te pā la dgon du yang / /khyed nyid byon nas dbyar gnas btsugs dgos zer/ /de ltar kho1nga gis zhal gyis bzhes nas su/ /bla ma khong dang kame rdo rje gnyis/ /pā la dgon du byon nas dbyar gnas btsugs/ /de yi skabs su rdo rje phreng ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor zhe gnyis dbang dang dge legs su/ /byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum po'i dbang dang bcas/ /paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gsung ji bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor zhe lnga'i dbang rnams rdzogs par bskur/ /rang rang 'dod chos phul nas dbyar ljongs skabs/ /bzang ldan ri khrod mjal byon lam bar du/ /rgyal ba bzang gi gdung rten phug pa r+sā /sngon 'gro rgyas pa 'don mthar brag ngos nas/ /ngo mtshar smad byung sa ts+tsha zhig bton tshe/ /84

rnam thar grub gnyispo'ajo ba'i bum bzang /nged rnams pā la dgon par dgos zhus kyang / /khong gis rtsed mo'i tshul gyis de mi 'ong / /mdang nub rgyal ba bzang gis nga rang la/ /gnang ba yin gsungs da skabs khong nyid kyi/ /sku gdung nang la gzungs gzhug phul nas yod/ /pā la dgon nas mar la byon skabs su/ /sug pa 'thibs yod grwa 'khor mang na yang / /bla ma'i steng nas 'dom gang lhag pa'i mthar/ /'od zer dkar po zlum po rgyab yol ltar/ /sne gnyis lam la zugs pa gsal la 'tsher/ /bla ma gar byon yod pa kun gyis mthong / /ci yin khong la zhus tshe 'ja' ltar du/ /kha dog med pas mi shes 'ja' yin na/ /rgyal ba bzang po'i thugs dgyes e yin snyam/ /de nas khang gsar dgon byon phur sgrub kyi/ /dbu ba mdzad nas chos khrid sna tshogs byas/ /de nas shwa mda'i dgon du mchod rten la/ /85

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ardzo ba'i bum bzang /rab gnas byas rjes slar yang 'dzam thang phebs/ /de yi dbyar khar bdud 'dul mchod rten nang / /'jim sku dus gsum sangasargyas nyan thos gnyis/ /sbyangs ba bla ma gang gi sku brtan bzhengs/ /'di skor lnga phyi zhig la skyabs mgon rje/ /sa dmar mchog sprul kun dga' gang nyid kyis/ /'phrin bskur ltar du dza 'gos ri khrod byon/ /de tshe sa dmar mchog sprul gang gis gtsos/ /thun pa sogs kyis ser phreng bsu ma byas/ /sa dmar sprul skus zhu ba po mdzad nas/ /mchog sprul dam pa gang gis gtsor mdzad de/ /ser skya yongs la dus 'khor khrom dbang bskur/ /gzhan yang mthong don 'khrul 'khor khrid sogs gnang / /de skabs mchog sprul dam pa gang nyid kyis/ /bshad pa dang bcas maṇ+ḍal rgya chen 'bul/ /khyad par rang gi lus dang longs spyod dang / /gtso bo rdo rje slo ma 'di rnams ni/ /86

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /bla ma khyed la 'bul ba yin gsungs nas/ /spyir na ri khrod 'di yi rtsa ba ni/ /thug sa bla ma chos rje tshang yin pas/ /rang nyid tshe gcig bdag po ma yin kyang / /nyin gcig rdzi bo tsam byas da skabs su/ /dkyil 'khor bshams yag steng du bum pa yang /'jog yag zer ba ltar du ma yin kyang / /sngar gyi nyams pa zhig gso tsam re byas/ /da ni bla ma chos rje khyed nyid kyi/ /phyag tu bdag gis bde mor 'phrod pa yin/ /phyin chad bdag po byed pa rem rem gsung / /de nas bla ma grwa 'khor rim bzhin du/ /dgon lag rnams su phebs nas shwa mdar thon/ /de tshe mchog sprul gshegs pa'i skad thon nas/ /myur bar ri khrod byang chub chos rdzong byon/ /gdung mchod gdung zhu la sogs legs par bgyis/ /dbu chos rnams kyis sprul sku'i zhal bkod ltar/ /87

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /da wa khyedanyidabazhugs nas bdag po byed dgos zhus/ /de tshe bla ma'i rdo rje slob dpon zhig /chos rjes bkod bsgrigs byas nas mngag zhes gsungs/ /slar yang shwa mda' bkra shis sgang sogs su/ /byon nas dbang khrid gnang ste 'dzam thang phebs/ /dgung lo re dgu'i steng du sngar bzhin du/ /bsgrub grwa pa la khrid dang mchog dbang gnang / /lo der ru sde'i nang la rgyu bsod byas/ /rta nor thams cad tshong ba gnyis la gtad/ /de yi dbyar kha ru sde'i mchod rten zhes/ /sgrib sel thugs rten chen mo bzhengs mgo brtsams/ /lo der bdud 'dul mchod rten nang la yang / /reb gong lha bzo 'brug thar rgyal sogs kyis/ /phur ba rta mgrin mi 'khrugs sman bla dang / /kun mkhyen thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal/ /'od dpag med pa gtso 'khor gsum po dang / /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyag bzhi tshe dpag med/ /88

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /sa dmar sprul sku'i sku 'dra sbyangs sprul rje/ /kun dga' dpal dang 'jigs med dbang po yi/ /sku 'dra rje btsun tā ra nā tha dang / /khang dmar bla ma'i sku 'dra legs par bzhengs/ /chos 'dor nas bzung rim bzhin sgog shing ngor/ /dbu gzungs mgrin gzungs dang ni stod gzungs sogs/ /bla med rnal 'byor rgyud dang bya spyod rgyud/ /sgog shing gzungs dang mdo gzungs gzungs chen yang / /'bum phrag mang po dri med rnam gnyis kyi/ /dkyil 'bor tshad ldan gnod sbyin bang mdzod nang / /ser skya bud med ca lag cha tshang dang / /gter bum mang bzhag mchod rten 'di yi nang / /sngar bzhedas kun mkhyen sku 'dra lnga brgya bzhag /sgrib sel mchod rten nang la lha bzo yang / /'dzin pa sogs kyis chos sku rdo rje bachang / /sangs rgyas rnam gzigs thugs rje chen po dang / /chos skyong dpal ldan mgon po gur sogs bzhengs/ /89

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /de yi ston khar bla ma khro skyabs byon/ /tshe g.yang grwa ba dpal kos skyel ma byas/ /'od grags 'brug rgyal gnyis po bsu mar thon/ /dgon par bzhugs nas skya ser yongs rdzogs la/ /dus 'khor dbang chen nyin bdun bskur nas gzhan/ /bka' brgyad gu drag seng gdong thos grol dang / /tshe dbang sogs kyi dbang lung ma ṇi gsungs/ /de nas khyim gdan phebs nas rgyu bsod byas/ /lung pāl dgon song ser skya yongs rdzogs la/ /bsnyung gnas sdom pa lha dgu'i dbang yang gnang / /ma ṇi gsungs nas mi skya pho mo rnams/ /dge sgrub sdig spang byed mi mang po byung / /de nas mar byon lcags zam gru khar thon/ /tshe lha nor bu tshang bzhugs phyir nyin du/ /tshe lha nor bus grog sa bcas thugs chen la/ /mjal byon 'od grags 'brug rgyal tshe g.yang rnams/ /bla ma khur res byas nas la sked tsam/ /90

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /thon nas a thang chad tshe rgya sar lngas/ /bla mar nged rnams khur zer re mos byas/ /myur bar bud song nged rnams rjes ma chod/ /nged rnams thon tshe bla ma bzhugs 'dug par/ /de rnams gar song zhus tshe 'khor khang 'di'i/ /nang la bud song gsungs nas nged rang tshos/ /gong 'og bar gsum btsal kyang rnyed rgyu med/ /phyis su 'brog la dre(na skabs snang gsal gyis/ /lo rgyus zhus tshe de bden 'khor khang nas/ /ma bud tshe na ci yin snyam mo gsungs/ /de ni rgyal chen sku lnga'i sprul bar nges/ /gnas der jo mdun rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang / /rim gnyis smon lam la sogs smon lam yang / /rgya cher btab nas slar yang 'dzam thang phebs/ /dgung lo bdun cu tham pa'i steng la yang / /sngar ltar sgrub grwa pa la chos khrid byas/ /lo der dus 'khor mchod rten bzhengs mgo bzung / /91

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /sgrib sel mchod rten nang la nyag rong gi /lha bzo 'jigs med sogs kyis kyi rdor dang / /'jigs byed bde mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas dang / /gsang 'dus mi bskyod ma hā mā ya dang / /e ka tsa ti dpal ldan lha mo sogs/ /bum pa'i nang la thugs rje chen po yang / /phyag stong spyan stong thog tshad phyed lhag bzhengs/ /lo der dbyar gnas mkhan po mdzad skabs su / /grwa tshang yongs la rgyud sde rab 'byams dbang / /yongs rdzogs zla ba gsum lhag gsungs nas gzhan/ /phyag rdor dug sbyong dbang dang gcod kyi dbang / /nam mkha' sgo 'byed gtso 'dus dbang sogs gsungs/ /lo der dus lubor mchod rten chen mo sa /gu ru gtso 'khor gsum dang bka' brgyad dang / /gu grags ra phur 'byung 'dul tshe dbang sogs/ /thos grol khrag 'thung che mchog yab yum dang / /phyag drug seng gdong spyan gzigs phyag bzhi pa/ /92

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /bum pa'i nang du dus kyi 'khor yang / /zhal phyag yongs rdzogs 'bar ma brgyad bcas bzhengs/ /bdud 'dul mchod rten sgrib sel mchod rten dang / /dus 'khor mchod rten sogs kyi gser tog rnams/ /dus gcig mgar nas gser rtsi 'byug pa'i tshe/ /zad la nye ba'i kha tshang mi 'dang ngam/ /zhus tshe mi skyon g.yang 'bod byed gsungs nas/ /phyir nyin 'dang nas ma zad cung lhag pas/ /khong ni nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes zhes/ /gser bzo ba rnams ngo mtshar dad pa skyes/ /mchod rten rnams la gser tog 'dzugs skabs su/ /sa gzhi lan gsum g.yos te ngo mtshar ba'i/ /rtags rnams du ma snga phyir mang po byung / /khong nyid dgun khar bzhag shod dgon lngar byon/ /dgung lo don gcig sgrub grwa pa rnams la/ /khrin gnang zla ba gnyis par mchog dbang dang / /'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor dbang rnams bskur/ /93

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /nyin gcig gdug bsrung byis pa nad drag pos/ /'chi la nye tshe khong gis khrus tshe 'gugs/ /gsungs nas da khyod ma ngu sos la yod/ /zhes gsung byis pa'i chu thon myur du sos/ /de skabs zhig tu shug mda' 'gam nang gi /gzhi bdag mdzod gter slar gso byed pa la/ /bla ma byon nas nyi shar ri rtser thon/ /de tshe skrug pa chags yod dpa' mkhar gsos/ /dpung rgyan 'dzugs skabs kha dog sna lnga'i 'ja'/ /gsal zhing dwangs ba rnga zlum lta bu zhig /dpa' mkhar steng du shar ba kun gyis mthong / /de nas mar babs bla ma'i tshe dbang bskur/ /tsha li zhes pa'i sil tog shel dam gang / /de yis tshe rdzas byas nas skya mi yang / /brgya phrag tsam la re re bzhin gnang nas/ /lhag ma phyed tsam yod pas kun ngo mtshar/ /nyin cig bla brang nang byon gzigs pa'i tshe/ /94

rnam thar grub gnyispo'adzo ba'i bum bzang /khang steng rtswa skyes thigs chus nang gang bas/ /khong gis bdag ma byas tshe zhig 'gro gsungs/ /bla brang nang spor khang pa zhig gso byas/ /gyang lha rnams kyang lha bzo na nam gyis/ /zla ba mang po'i bar du slar gso byas/ /dgun khar jo ser sum bcu tsam la yang / /dpal sprul sngon 'gro'i khrid lung spel ma dang / /ma 'das gang gi dpal gyi mgur bzang nas/ /thon pa'i rnam grangs mdo slob khrid lung dang / /gsung 'bum cha tshang lung dang dus 'khor gyi/ /chos 'byung khang dmar bla ma'i rnam thar dang / /skyabs mgon s+thāngs ba bla ma'i rnam thar dang / /mkhar ba bla ma' rnam thar rta mgrin gyi/ /lus dkyil khrid lung grub rgyal ma yi lugs/ /tshe dpag med kyi lung rnams legs par gnang / /'di skor lha bzo grags pas mgon thang yang / /chos skyong cha tshang yod pa zhig kyang bris/ /95

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /sngon chad khong gis tshogs zangs gser sku'i ched/ /rgyu bsod byas nas tshogs zangs chu zom yang / /sum cu can dang khang dmar gser sku'i nang / /zhal 'debs lha tshogs lag la sgor khri gnyis/ /gzhan yang stong sgor drug dang bzhi brgya dang / /gro nas rgya ma stong gcig mar phyur sogs/ /du ma dang bcas zangs dkar che chung gnyis/ /dngul srang drug rnams gser sku'i cha rkyen phul/ /dgung lo don gnyis sgrub khang sgrol ma 'tshogs/ /sgrub grwa pa la khrid rnams legs par gnang / /de nas khong gis dbyar gnas mkhan po mdzad/ /rta mgrin 'byung 'dul rme brtsegs rjes gnang dang / /rjes gnang brgyad rtsa grub chen brgyad cu yi/ /rjes gnang sgrol ma nyer gcig gtor chog gi /rjes gnang cha tshang bde mchog lha lnga dang / /na ga raka seng gdong sngon mo bcas/ /rjes gnang mang bskur khang gsar mgon khang nang / /96

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /phyog gnyis gyang lha rnams kyang zhig gasku byas/ /'jim pa las bzos chos skyong sku brnyan rnams/ /'byung 'dul gur mgon e ka tsa ti dang / /dpal ldan lha mo pu ṭa ming sring bcas/ /drakad rnam sras zhal sogs lus tshad tsam/ /yod pa bzhengs te ston khar khang dmar gyi/ /rten khang nang bzhugs rgyal ba'i bsku rnyan yang / /zangs gser las bskrun gsung 'byon ma dang ni/ /nyid kyis bzhengs ba'i rgyal ba'i thugs rten che/ /bkra shis sgo mang bdud 'dul mchod rten dang / /sgrib sel dus 'khor mchod rten rnam bzhi dang / /'du khang rten phug kun mkhyen stong sku sogs/ /sku gsung thugs rten rnams dang gos sku yang / /che chung mang po bla brang byams sku sogs/ /'dzam thang dgon gyi sku gsung thugs kyi rten/ /yod do cog la rab gnas chen mo 'tshogs/ /khang dmar rab gnas 'gro phan rgyas byed kyi/ /97

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /khri ba bla ma khong dang sbyangs sprul rje/ /shes rab rgyal mtshan srib lung ri khrod kyi/ /bla ma rin bzang sogs dang tshes bcu yi/ /sprul sku bsod nams bzang sogs bla sprul yang / /bzhi bcu lhag dang 'du khang chen mo rtswa /bla ma chos 'phags dbur bcas bla sprul yang / /nyis brgya lhag gis dus 'khor rnying pa la/ /rab gnas btags te gdung mdun mchog sprul rje/ /kame bsod nams dpon g.yog rab gnas 'tshogs/ /'ja' 'od sna tshogs 'phro zhing khad 'jam pa/ /gnam gshis dwangs ba la sogs dge mtshan mang / /nyin rer ser phreng byas nas rten rnams la/ /me tog 'thor zhing nyi ma tha mar yang / /ser phreng byas nas dus 'khor mchod rten la/ /me tog 'thor tshe bya rgod thang dkar gsum/ /mchod rten steng du nye ba'i nam mkha' r+sā /g.yas phyog lding 'khor byas mthar byang phyogs 'phur/ /98

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /de tshe bla sprul 'ga' yi gzigs snang la/ /sbyangs ba ma 'das nyid kyis zhal gzigs gsung / /dgung lo don gsum sgrub grwa pa rnams khrid/ /khong gis glang chen ri khrod ni gu bka'/ /phyi nang rgyu lus dbang mo che bcas gnang / /'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor dbang bskur nas/ /de yi sos kar spyong rgyud bcu gnyis dbang / /rjes gnang brgyad rtsa grub chen brgyad cu dang / /gtor chog cha tshang sgrol ma ljang mo'i dbang / /thub pa rdor gdan gnas bstan bcu drug dang / /gdugs dkar rnam rgyal ma dang lha dgu'i dbang / /sgrol dkar khyung khra sogs kyi rjes gnang gsung / /nyin cig rje btsun a ne+e shi song ba'i/ /dgong zhag skabs su khang steng nas bltas tshe/ /bla mas chibs pa rag ser cig zhon nas/ / ser mo zhig gis rta kha khrid nas su/ /shar gyi phyogs su byon pa 'brul med mthong / /99

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /nyin gong rje btsun khyim la 'ong skabs su/ /bla ma dpon g.yog gsum po bzhugs nas yod/ /bdag gis de ring bla ma gar byon zhus/ /nga ni gang la ma song bzhugs 'dug gsungs/ /grwa ba gnyis kyis rgad po don mchog la/ /sgo n+da ཿgras zhig byas pa ma gtogs par/ /gang la ma byon zer nas de'i nyin par/ /sman chos kyis kyang rta bcas de ltar mthong /mthong ba 'khrul med yin de bla ma'i skus/ /ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul bkod pa gnyis su bstan/ /sa zla'i khri ba mdzad de rdul mtshon steng / /bla sprul sum brgya lhag la dus 'khor dbang / /skyabs mgon sbyangs ba'i snyes 'khor dbang yig ltar/ /slob ma rjes 'dzin sta gon dngos gzhi yang / /byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun mchog dbang dang / /mchog dbang khyad par can dang slob dpon dbang / /bdag po bdag chen la sogs nyin bdun bskur/ /100
