rnamatharagrubaganyisa'ajoba'iḍimabazang/ser skya yongs la rdo rje mi 'khyugs pa/ /dus 'khor lha dgu'i dbang gnyis khrom dbang byas/ /de yi ston kha nas bzung 'du khang gi /shing brkos cha rkyen grwa tshang yongs rdzogs kyis/ /'don bcol 'tshogs te bla mas mgo 'dren byas/ /rgyu rdzas rta phyugs mang rnyed dpal ko dang / /tshong ba gnyis kyis rogs dang bdag gnyer byas/ /khal g.yag sum brgya tsam zhig tshe thar btang / /ston phyogs rje dbon 'jigs med rgya mtsho yi / /gzugs sku chos dbyings bsdus pas gdung mchod kyi/ /bya ba rnams gnang de yi dgun kha n+da/ /grwa ba rig don gyis byas tsha khor byon/ /dgung lo don bzhir son pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /bla ma yon dpal la sogs sgrub grwa bar/ /sngar bzhin gang dgos chos khrid sna tshogs byas/ /lo de'i sa zla'i khri 'dzin khong nyid byon/ /dbyar khar stong skor lha bzo chos 'dzin dang / /101

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /dge 'dun gnyis kyi pha ri'i sgrub khang nang / /rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyi zhing thang bris/ /khang gsar rgyal khang nang la rdor shugs dang / /'jigs byed 'byung 'dul rta mgrin gur gyi mgon/ /e ka tsa ti dpal ldan lha mo dang / /pu ṭa ming sring ru 'dren sde bzhi'i tshogs/ /phyag drug drakad rnam sras zhal bzhi pa/ /mkha' 'gro sde lnga chos rgyal nag sman dang / /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las rgyal po lnga/ /tsi dmar dang bcas che ba lus tshad tsam/ /chung rnams khru tsi gsum tsam yod pa bzhengs/ /bla brang nang la sbyangs sprul sku 'dra dang / /sa 'khor sdom chen gu ru rin po che/ /dus 'bor yongs rdzogs gdugs dkar rin 'byung ltar/ /rnam rgyal ma dang ṇ+ḍi dpag med mgon dang / /thugs rje chen po kun rig rnams 'jim sku/ /shākya thub pa rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa'i/ /102

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /sku brnyan zangs gser las bskrun lus tshad ma/ /chung ba tsam bzhengs de yi ston phyogs su/ /shing brkos cha rkyen grwa tshang yongs rdzogs bsdus/ /'don bcol 'tshogs te bca' lag sgor mo dang / /rta zog brgya lhag gnyer ba gnyis la gtad/ /drug mchod khri ba byon nas rdul tshon steng / /dus 'bor sdom chen sta gon dngos gzhi'i dbang / /nyin gsum bskur nas lha dgu mi 'khrugs pa/ /tshe dbang lha gcig bum gcig sbyangs sprul gsung / /tshe dpag med mgon lha dgu'i khrom dbang bskur/ /smre brtsegs rjes gnang mgon po khro bcu yi/ /rjes gnang bskur nas kun mkhyen rnam thar dang / /rgyal sras lag len gang thugs dbyings la the gas/ /yab sras bco lnga'i rnam thar lung rnams gsungs/ /dgung lo don lngar sgrub grwa pa rnams khrid/ /lha bzo chos 'dzin zhes pas lo der yang / /bde chen zhing thang rdo rje mi zhabrugs pa/ /103

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /lha dgu'i thang ga rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /'jigs byed ro langs brgyad bskor la sogs pa/ /thang sku che ba bzhi bcu tsam bris te/ /sgrub khang nang bzhag 'tshogs khang sgo 'byor nang / /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi thang ga che ba dang / /rigs drug 'khor lo'i gyang thang che ba bzhengs/ /'du khang rgya mthongs dus 'khor lha dgu dang / /bde chen zhing thang phur ba'i thang ga dang / /lhung bshags gu ru'i thang sku 'du khang nang / /shing brkos shing tshon thams cad mdzes par grub/ /de nas sgo 'byor shing brkos dgos gsungs te/ /de yi ston khar grwa tshang yongs rdzogs bsdus/ /'don bcol 'tshogs nas rgyu rdzas sngar ltar byas/ /de nas shug nang dpal rtse dgon pa sa /mchod rten rab gnas byon skabs khong nyid kyis/ /mgo log rgya bla pad+ma rnam rgyal gyi/ /mdun nas rta mgrin lus dkyil sems khrid zhus/ /104

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /bla ni gsal ldan mjal nas sems khrid dang / /dus 'khor lhan skyes lung dang gtsang sprul rje/ /blo gros rnam rgyal gang la lhan skyes dang / /sems khrid zhus shing bya yur dgon de yi/ /bla ma chos mdzod dang ni chos thang gi /bla ma snang stong gnyis la chos 'brel zhus/ /mkhas grub gnyis ldan bla ma blos 'phrin dang / /tshes bcu'i mchog sprul bsod nams bzang po dang / /rnga yul 'jigs med rdo rje khong rnams la/ /chos zhus bla ma rin chen brtson 'grus kyi/ /mdun nas dus 'khor lhan skyes sems khrid zhus/ /khong la rta sogs 'bul ba rgya cher byas/ /de nas sham+bha la yi zhang thang gi /ma dpe g.yar nas tshur 'ongs chos 'dzin la/ /brir bcug 'du khang sgo 'byor nang la bzhag /dge 'dun bzhugs grwar 'bol gdan bzang po sogs/ /'tshogs khang phyi nang shing brkos tshon dang bcas/ /105

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /thams cad legs grub byung ba'i las mi rnams/ /gla dang ston mo sogs kyis mgu bar byas/ /de 'dra 'grub ston ras bris steng nyid nas/ /dus 'khor dbang chen nyin bdun khrom dbang bskur/ /de skabs 'brog pa rnams la grub brnyes kyi/ /bla ma myi bzang gang gi zhal gsung la/ /rga bla khong ni shā ra'i bu yin pas/ /dbang nyan 'gro na shin tu bzang gsung tshe/ /thams cad dbang nyan 'ongs nas mthar rdzogs skabs/ /mjal kha gnang nas ri dwags rngon pa dang / /jag rkun 'dzing 'khon thams cad bcad du bcug /ha k+ṣa ma ṇi la sogs dge bsgrub dang / /sdig spang byed mi mang byung khong gis kyang / /chos dang 'jig rten bslab bya'i kun gyi blo/ /chos la bsgyur zhing ser skya yongs rdzogs la/ /rgyal chen sku lnga'i bka' gtad byas rjes su/ /bla sprul gnyis kyis mi skya thams cad la/ /106

rnam thar grugaganyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /re re bzhin du dge sdig spang blang dang / /nang brkas 'khon 'dzing mi byed khas blang bcug /de nas khong gis drug mchod khri ba mdzad/ /lo der chos rje mchog sprul dam pa rje/ /kame bdud 'dul rdo rje gang nyid dang / /thun pa du mar spyor drug zab khrid gnang / /snga phyi du mar sbyor drug pa rnams bskyang / /de rjes rang re'i bu dgon dza 'go dang / /bzhag shod dgon lnga sogs la phebs pa'i tshe/ /grwa ba rje btsun rig don gnyis byas nas/ /pā la dgon par nyi ma bdun tsam ring / /dus 'khor lha dgu'i dbang dang mchog dbang gsung / /de tshe dge mtshan 'ja' 'od sna tshogs pa/ /shar ba der gnas kun gyis 'khrul med mthong / /rta phyag khyung gsum thugs rje chen po'i dbang / /tshe dbang mi zhakhrugs pa yi dbang rnams bskur/ /ser mo rnams kyi tshong bcad lo thun dang / /107

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /zla thun sogs la 'dug rgyu khas len byas/ /khong gis chos bshad byas te kun gyi blo/ /chos la bsgyur te mi skya pho mo rnams/ /dge sdig spang blang byed mi mang po byung / /khyim tshang mang pos gdan zhus gro nas dang / /sgor mo mang rnyed thams cad sgor khri gsum/ /pā la dgon du gyang thang bzhengs ba'i rgyur/ /bla ma 'go 'gon sogs kyi phyag tu sprad/ /cem la bzhag ra zer ba tshang 'dug nas/ /rdo rje miri 'byugs pa dang spyan ras gzigs/ /tshe dpag med kyi dbang dang ma ṇi gsung / /de tshe sgor mo stong gcig bzhi brgya lhag /gro nas gang rnyed mchod rten cha rkyen bzhag /de nas char bag kun ldan tshang la bzhugs/ /thugs rje chen po gangs ri ma yi dbang / /rdo rje mi zhabrugs pa dang tshe dbang gsungs/ /rdzed dbon tshang blangs rgyu rdzas chud tshad de/ /108

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /mchod rten gdan par bzhag nas ri khrod byon/ /sa dmar sprul sku'i gdung mchod khri ba dang / /phur ba'i bsgrub dpon byas nas ser skya yongs/ /dus 'khor mchog dbang rdo rje mi zhabrugs pa'i/ /dbang gsung de nas ya mda'i dgon la byon/ /bla ma blo gros la mjal lhan skyes dang / /chags med bde smon sogs kyi chos 'brel gnang / /rdo rje mi 'khrugs dbang dang tshe dbang dang / /ma ṇi gsungs nas ser mo rnams la yang / /dgon par rgyun du lo thun zla thun la/ /'dug dgos gsungs nas de ltar khas kyang blang / /sgor mo stong phrag brgyad tsam bstan bcos kyi/ /blu yon cha rkyen bzhag nas lir rdzeb byon/ /khyim tshang mang pos gdan zhus ma ṇi gsungs/ /'bru rigs rgya ma sum brgya mchod rten gyi/ /gdan pa bzhag nas sag ra dgon la byon/ /rta mgrin thugs rje chen po'i rjes gnang dang / /109

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /mi 'khrugs pa yi dbang dang ma ṇi gsungs/ /khyim la gdan 'dren zhus mi mang po byung / /rgyu rdzas rnyed tshad lha khang gdan pa bzhag /de skabs 'dzam thang phyogs la 'phrin bskur nas/ /sbyangs sprul bstan 'dzin nyi mar sgrub grwa pa/ /khyed kyis khrid dgos gsungs nas lo yang sar /dgung lo don drug steng du rdzed ta ro/ /bkra shis don 'grub tshang la bzhugs nas su/ /mi 'khrugs pa dang thugs rje chen po'i dbang / /ma ṇi la sogs gsung skabs dal 'byor gyi/ /rten thob dka' tshul la sogs chos mang gsungs/ /gro nas rnyed tshad mchod rten gdan par bzhag /de nas dpon 'dzin la byon khyim gdan byas/ /sngon chad lha khang gcig yod de nyid yang / /lhar gso byed dgos gsung tshe thamasacad kyis/ /nyen kha che bas las byed mi phod zer/ /skyon med bdag gis gsol kha 'don gsung nas/ /110

rnam thar grub gnyir+sā'ajo ba'i bum bzang /bla mas ṇi gsung zhor las byed bcug /sgor mo stong phrag gnyis dang brgya phrag bzhi/ /cha rkyen byas nas lha khang legs po bzhengs/ /de nas li tog la byon sngar bzhin du/ /dbang dang ma ṇi gsung zhing sgor stong gnyis/ /skyi khang nang du thebs bzhag za lar byon/ /mang pos ja zhus dbang dang ma ṇi gsungs/ /sgor mo stong phrag gcig dang drug brgya tsam/ /khang gsar dgon gyi byams khang chen mo sa /dus gsum sangs rgyas 'jam dpal phyag bzhi pa/ /sogs kyi sku brnyan bzhengs ba'i cha rkyen bcas/ /khang gsar dgon la byon skabs ser phreng dang / /che bsu byas nas 'tshogs chen khri ba mdzad/ /skya ser yongs la dus 'khor mchog dbang dang / /lha dgu'i dbang dang thugs rje chen po dang / /tshe dbang mda' 'phel ma dang ma ṇi gsungs/ /sdig pa'i nyes dmigs dge ba'i phan yon rnams/ /111

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /gsung bamami rnams blo kha chos la bsgyur/ /'di skor cha mdo'i gser sku btsong mkhan thon/ /thub sku mi yi lus tshad tsam zhig dang / /gser sku che ba gcig bcas 'dzam thang bskur/ /de nas 'bag kam 'bros byon tshe dbang dang / /thugs rje chen po'i dbang dang sngon 'gro'i khrid/ /bzang spyod mi zhabrugs pa yi ngo sprod dang / /kun rig dus 'khor thugs rje chen po dang / /rdo rje 'chang dang 'od dpag med sogs kyi/ /rtsa skyed lung rnams dang ni ma ṇi gsungs/ /the(ga dngul stong phrag gcig dang bzhi brgya lhag /mchod rten lhar gso byed pa'i cha rkyen bzhag /khos ra byon nas mi zhabrugs pa yi dbang / /dus 'khor bstod ring lung gnang khyim gdan byas/ /mchod rten dung 'khor bzhengs ba'i cha rkyen du/ /sgor mo stong phrag gcig dang brgyad tsam bzhin/ /de nas yar 'ong mkho yag gyang sgang gnyis/ /112

rnam thatha grub gnyisa'ardzo ba'i bum bzang /sbra gur phub nas nyi ma bdun gyi bar/ /thugs rje chen po'i dbang dang mi 'khrugs pa/ /rta phyag khyung gsum sme brtsegs rjes gnang dang / /tshe dbang lha gcig bum gcig ma ṇi gsungs/ /thon nyin sbrang ma shin tu che ba gcig /'phur te gur nang bla ma'i mdun cog steng / /babs nas nyin mtshan med par 'dug na yang / /zhag ma drug nyin sbrang ma shi 'dug pas/ /phyi nyin bla mas sbrang ma'i gshog pa nas/ /bzung ste dbang nyan yongs la 'bu 'di nyid/ /gnyid dam shi 'am mi shes ma ṇi 'don/ /gsung tshe kun gyis ma ṇi bsngo smon byas/ /yang yang bla mas de 'dra byas pa'i mthar/ /de yi dgong mor kun gyis dge bsngo dang / /bde smon 'don skabs sbrang ma yar gson te/ /gur nang g.yas skor lan gsum byas nas su/ /nub phyogs mkha' la 'phur song mi kun gyis/ /113

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /de mthong thams cad bzhad gad thag ge song / /ci yin mi shes ngo mtshar ba zhig go /bla mas sa btsal sde khag gnyis po yi/ /mchod rten bzhengs rgyur khong gis sgor stong drug /bzhag nas gyang sgang dgon pa'i thang sku'i rgyur/ /slong mo byas nas sgor mo stong bdun bzhag /de nas mar 'ong shwa mda'i dgon du byon/ /bstan rgyas mgon rgyal mgo ba shes rab sogs/ /rogs byas khyim gdan phebs nas nyin gsum la/ /mchod rten rab gnas thugs rje chen po yi/ /rjes gnang mi 'khrugs dbang dang ma ṇi gsungs/ /bla mas 'du khang dgos gsung de'i gdan par/ /sgor mo khri phrag gcig dang stong phrag bzhi/ /snam bu ja dang phyugs rigs lcags snyed sogs/ /bzhag nas dpal ldan bkra shis sgang la byon/ /ser skya yongs la gtor chog cha tshang gi /rjes gnang thugs rje chen po tshe dbang dang / /114

rnam tharazugaganyisa'ajo ba'i bumobazang/ma ṇi gsungs nas rgyal chen 'bri gla la/ /slong mo byas nas sgor mo stong bdun tsam/ /dngul gyi gdub bu cha gcig nas rgya ma / /brgya dang lnga bcu ja sgam gcig rnam bzhag /btsag dgon bkra shis chos gling la byon nas/ /thugs rje chen po'i rjes gnang mi 'khrugs pa'i/ /dbang dang ma ṇi bsnyang gnas 'du khang gi /cha rkyen slong mo byas te sgor stong gnyis/ /'bri lnga ba bdun glang bzhi ltol mo gnyis/ /snam bu gcig bzhag ka to seng ge dgon/ /gro nas rgya ma stong dang lnga brgya tsam/ /thang sku'i yon sbyin chos bshad ma ṇi gsungs/ /'pho ba gsung skabs nyan mi mang po 'gyel/ /sngon chad bkra shis sgang tshang bud med zhig /chur lhung shi 'dre log zer khyim nang gis/ /bla mar zhus te grwa 'khor du ma bcas/ /chu khar phebs te 'pho lung gzab ldan gsungs/ /115

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /khyo bor da lo dge slong bzhi sde la/ /gung tshigs drongs dang 'dre med mo rang yang /skyid sa zhig tu skye gsung khotag ste/ /phyag mang btsal nas bkra drin che zhu zer/ /de nas mar byon rgyal rong khog la song / /sngon man rat+na shri'i 'byungs yul thon/ /bla ma mgon po rdo rjes grogs byas nas/ / —pho dres bye ma'i thang der ser skya yongs/ /thugs rje chen po'i rjes gnang mi zhabrugasapa'i/ /dbang dang ma ṇi gsungs te skyes pa rnams/ /ri dwags rngon dang chang bcad bud med rnams/ /dud chang bcad dang bla ser dgon nang la/ /rnam gsum gos med 'ong mi chog pa'i khrims/ /legs par bzhag nas rasne shri rje/ /zhabrungs ba'i sa der mchod rten bzhengs dgos gsungs/ /'bru rigs rgya ma stong brgyad ja bag gcig /gser zhwa gcig dang snam bu gsum sogs bzhag /116

rnam thar grub gnyis 'jo ba'i bum bzang /ru sder 'dud 'then 'khor lo bzhi bcu lhag /yod pa de tsho'i mi rnams khong nyid kyis/ /phyag mdud btags nas sa rdo nyin gnyis gsum/ /gla mi dgos par len rgyu byas rjes su/ /mchod rten mgo 'dren mgon po rdo rje bzhag /kyo 'bo dgon la lha sku 'bri ched du/ /'bru rigs mang byin de nas gyang 'dzar byon/ /rgya rong 'od gsal bla ma phun tshogs gnyis/ /grogs byas thugs rje chen po'i rjes gnang dang / /ma ṇi gsung zhing chosabashad dga' ston 'gyed/ /rnyed pa 'bru rigs rgya ma bzhi brgya tsam/ /de ru mchod rten bzhengs ba'i cha rkyen bzhag /'byar dgon la yang zhal 'debs cung zad byas/ /de nas 'dzam thang yar byon sa zla yi/ /khri ba khong gis mdzad cing sbyangs sprul rje/ /shes rab rgyal mtshan gzugs sku chos dbyings su/ /thim pas mya ngan byas te khong la yang / /117

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /sku gdung zhig dgos gsung nas sngar bzhengs ba'i/ /bkra shis sgo mang byang phyogs lha khang gcig /bzhengs ba'i shar sgor legs ldan mched gsum dang / /gdugs dkar nub sgo'i nang la 'od dpag med/ /sgrol ma ljang mo tshe dpag med rnams yang / /'jim sku thog tshad re re khang steng der/ /mchod rten khra le gcig gi mtha' skor du/ /mchod rten dkar ser dmar ljang bco brgyad bzhengs/ /tsha khor byon shul shi ba'i 'pho rta sogs/ /rgyu rdzas rnyed tshad bkra shis sgo mang gi /mtha' skor mchod rten kha dog sna tshogs pa/ /brgya dang bcu gsum gzungs gzhug byas pa bzhengs/ /dgun khar sngar bzhengs bdud 'dul mchod rten de/ /'gyel song yul mi rnams kyis bla ma la/ /mchod rten zhig pas thugs 'tsher ma mdzad dang / /ru sde yongs kyis grogs byed zhus pa'i tshe/ /khong gis thugs 'tsher mdzad rgyu ci yang med/ /118

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /mchod rten ngan 'gror 'gro ba'i dogs pa med/ /de bas sdig can mi 'chi ngan 'gror dogs/ /zhes gsungs kun gyis khri bcu'i stag lha de/ /nag nyes yod pas de nyid btsal dgos zhes/ /bla ma'i zhal nas de 'dra zer mi nyan/ /stag lha'i drin la slar yang mchod rten zhig /bzhengs rgyu'i bsod nams yod pas drin che gsungs/ /pā la 'bos 'bos ban de shi song rkyen/ /der byon dge rtsar dus 'khor khrom dbang bskur/ /dkyil 'khor cha rkyen kho rang tshang gis byas/ /dgung lo don bdun sgrub grwa pa rnams la/ /chos khrid gnang ste dus 'khor mchog dbang dang / /rjes gnang 'ga' re gsungs nas sos khar yang / /dpal 'dzin mgo khrid rnams kyisamago 'dren byas/ /ru sde'i mi skya pho mo thams cad 'dus/ /mchod rten zhig pa'i sa rdo legs par bsal/ /brag bar phyogs nas rdo bzo shing bzo rnams/ /119

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /'chi med rig 'dzin rig 'dzin rnam rgyal sogs/ /rtsig bzo sum cu tsam dang bud khang mda'i/ / bses bso thig par 'ongs te gza' skar yang / /'phrod sbyor 'dzom pa'i dus su las mgo brtsam/ /khong nyid sa zla'i khrir bzhugs dbyar kha sa /ru sde'i nang la rgyu bsod byon pa'i tshe/ /thog mar phyug skor tshang gi kha phab ste/ /ston pa'i gser sku rgya gar shar lim/ /rin thang gzhal med gcig dang 'bri g.yag sogs/ /che chung bcu dang rgyu rdzas sna mang 'bul /mi khyim re rer byon pas rta phyug dang / /g.yu byur rgyan gos la sogs rnyed pa bzang / /de skabs g.yag kyang sum brgya tshe thar byas/ /de nas khong gis dbyar gnas mkhan po byas/ /rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang gnang dbang gi mjug /dge tshul dge slong sdom gnang grwa gsar 'ga'/ /ma gtogs dge tshul dge slong bsgrub tu bcug /120

rnam thar grub gnyir+sā'ajo ba'i bum bzang /bstan ko la sogs slob ma 'ga' re yis/ /mchod rten srog shing gzungasagazhug rim par bsgrub/ /chos rje mchog sprul bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / /grwa tshang yongs rdzogs byon nas srog shing btsugs/ /mkha' la 'ja' 'od sna mogs kun gyis mthong / /slob ma la las nam mkhar ltos shig dang / /sbyangs ba sprul skus gzigs nas yod do zer/ /thang dkar rgod cig mchod rten nam mkha' la/ /dal bas g.yas bskor byas nas byang phyogs 'phur/ /mchod rten grub zin skabs su khong nyid kyis/ /nye gnas rnams la da ni 'du khang dang / /mchod rten la sogs legs par 'grub nye bas/ /bdag gis las ka'i mjug rdzogs sngon chad kyi/ /sbyangs pas gnang ba'i tshe dpag med mgon dang / /gser sku mang shos gser tog nang zhog gsungs/ /de gsung mi nyan tshe dpag med ma bzhag /khyed kyi sku tshe bskal brgyar bzhugs dgos zhus/ /1lha1

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /dusabab bzlog tu dka' ste khyed rnams shes/ /gsungs kyang nged rnams gser sku ma bzhag par/ /phyis su khong gi sku gdung nang la bzhag /lo de'i drug mchod khri ba khong gis mdzad/ /bla ser rnams la tshe 'di mi rtag tshul/ /'gro 'dug rnam gsum na bza' rgyan lugs dang / /nag chang rku dud skya chas 'dzem dgosagasungs/ /yul mi rang la drin che drin gzo'i phyir/ /bla brang cu rar bsnyung gnas ma ṇi dang / rin 'byung ltar gyi sgrol ma nyer gcig dang / /jo lugasasgrol ma rnams dang gzhan sgrol ma'i/ /rigs byed mang po rta phyag khyung gsum dang / /smre brtsegs rjes gnang tshe dbang rnams gnang ste/ /dge sdig spang blang lag len zhal gdamasadang / /zhal chems gsung bzhin dal 'byor rten thob pa/ /lan gcig yin te 'bad pa'i dus bab rem /zla gcig tsam gsungasasngar bzhengs mchod rten rnams/ /122

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /ru khag mgo khrid rnams dang dpal ko sogs/ /khyed la 'phrod pas zhig tu 'jug mi 'jug /khyed rnams shes gsungs de nas khyim tshang 'gar/ /rta mgrin bsgrub chen dbu blar byon rjes su/ /zhabs phyi dbang rgyal tshang byas gung rgyar phebs/ /mi skya pho mor dbang dang ma ṇi gsungs/ /rang gzhan 'chi la nye ste dam chos sgrubs/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rgyu 'bras ngang tshul gsungs/ /khyed rnams bdag la drin che da skabs su/ /drin gzo'i phyir 'ong rgyu rdzas ched min gsungs/ /skabs zhig khong la sku cham bzhesatshul bstan/ /'dzam thang mar byon kun gyis sman khang du/ /'gro dgos zhus tshe nga rang nad med pas/ / ci byed gsungs kyang kun gyis re 'dun ltar/ /rka mda'i sman khang nang byon re zhig bzhugs/ /i rje mardzo sprul bdud 2la rdo rje dang / /dpal ko la sogs dbu chosargan rim gyis/ /123

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /g.yu thog mchog sprul kame bsod nams sogs/ /phyogs kyi bla sprul rnams la mo lung zhus/ /grwa tshang yongs rdzogs 'dus te zhabs brtan 'tshogs/ /rta mgrin bsgrub chen lha dgu dbang stong dang / /gto rigs mang po dung yon du ma dang / /dgon pa mang por 'don bcol zhabs brtan phul/ /nye gnas gnyis kyis bzhugs zhus phul ma gnang / /khong nyid bskyed rdzogs rnal 'byor mchog brnyes pas/ /zhabs rkang ngos la sku ge mang po gsal/ /khyed rnams ltos gsung nged cag zhu ma phod/ /slar yang zhal nas yang yang 'don gsung tshe/ /rgyal yum 'phags ma'i gzungasasngags yi ge bcu/ /red ces nye gnas ris/ rdon zhu ba phul/ /sor bsam 'od gsal stong gzugs sgog 'dzin skabs/ /ro rkyang rlung rnams dbu mar mi shigs pa'i/ /thig ler thim pa'i rtags snang na dwa'i sgra/ /rtsa 'khor dbus su yi ge'i gzugs shar bas/ /124

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /bar skabs khong gis lte ba'i rtsa 'khor thad/ /yi ge mang po yod pas gos rnams khyogs/ /gsung tshe bdag cag res mos na bza' btegs / /rjes dran rnam kun dga' ma'i 'du byed las/ /thig le 'bar 'dzag lha sku rab 'byams kyi/ /'du 'phro'i snang ba 'gog med 'char ba'i rtags/ /bar skabs khong gis snying khar lha mang po/ /yod kyang da skabs khyed tshor bgo dgos sam/ /gsung tshe dgos zhus khong gis phyag lag gis/ /nye gnas rnams la re re gnang tshul mdzad/ /de 'dra mang gsung gdangs zhan don ma go/re 'ga' mi rtog 'od gsal ngang du bzhugs/ /re 'ga' dbang bzhi blang zhing gshegs gsol byas/ /da skabs rang nyid 'gror nye rgyu rdzas sogs/ /za rgyu 'thung rgyu ci yod thams cad kun/ /sman pa rnams la ster gsung sman pa rnams/ /skyes pa bzhi dang bu mo bdun tsam gyis/ /125

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /sku tshogs mang mdzad spyir na skyes pa'i yang / /tha mar 'chi ba zer ltar 'chi ba'i tshe/ /sangs rgyasadang ni byang sems sa thob la/ /bzang 'brel ma zad ngan 'brel yin kyang rung / /thar ba'i sa bon thebs na rang nyid ni/ /de 'dra min kyang tshegs 'bras yod nges pas/ /sman pa thams cad tshe rang lo brgya gsungs/ /rab byung bcu bdun bskal ba sa stag lor/ /bcu gnyis zla ba'i bcu bdun nub mo rtswa /'chi ba rjes dran bzhugs stangs chos gos bcas/ /rgyal ba mya ngan 'da' tshul ji bzhin ngang / /gzhi yi 'od gsal stong chen dbu ma'i sbubs/ /lam gyi 'od gsal ro gcig 'dres pa'i tshe/ /sa g.yo du ma ngo mtshar ltas dang bcas/ /khong gi dgong pa gzhi dbyings gshegs tshul bstan/ /nyin zhag bcu bzhir chos dbyings 'od gsal ngang / /bzhugs nas nyer bzhi'i nyin gung sbyangs sprul rje/ /126

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ardzo ba'i bum bzang /bstan 'dzin nyi ma gang gis thugs dam dkrogs/ /de nas bzung ste nyin zhag du ma'i bar/ /mkha' la 'ja' 'od kha dog sna tshogs dang / /dbyibs mi 'dra ba du ma sa gzhir yang / /drod chags chu chen dar chad ngo mtshar rtags/ /du ma byung ba ma 'dres kun la gsal/ /sku gdung sna tshogs longs sku'i chas gsol nas/ /nyer bzhi'i mtshan mor 'dzam thang 'du khang cher/ /spyan drangs chos rje grwa tshang yongs rdzogs 'dus/ /gdung mchod lha dgu 'tshogs te sngon 'gro dang / /bla mchod la sogs rang rang smon lam rigs/ /btab ste ser skya yongs dang phyogs kun nas/ /'ong rnams gdung mjal skabs su bla ser rnams/ /spyor drug sgrub grwa bsnyen mtshams khas len byas/ /mi skya pho mos bsad sha bcad pa dang / /ma ṇi ha k+ṣa dung dang phyag bskor sogs/ /dge sgrub sdig spangs ches mang kun la yang / /127

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /gtsang ba sku 'bring ngag dbang gang nyid kyis/ /deng dus stos pa'i chos pa rab yin pas/ /gdung mjal dad pa smon lam thob cig dang / /'jam dpal rtsa rgyud chos pa'i pur mjal na/ /mtshams med lnga yi sdig pa dag gsungs bas/ /khong gis dbu bskul bde smon la sogs pa/ /smon lam mang gsungs lo gsar tshes lnga'i nyin/ /bla brang yang thog zhugs 'bul byas pa'i tshe/ /rgyud sde lnga bsdus kun rig mi 'khrugs pa/ /dus 'khor rnam rgyal ma sogs sbyin bsreg phul/ /de tshe nam mkhar 'ja' 'od sna tshogs bkra /sa lam bar chad bsal phyir khro bo'i rgyal/ /rdo rje shugs kyi skur bzhengs me dpung sgra/ /e yin snyam ste 'ur sgra chen po grags/ /lha dang mkha' 'gro'i bsu mar phebs snyam ste/ /steng mkhar thang dkar rgod po du ma zhig /lding 'khor byas mthar byang gi phyogs su 'phur/ /128

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /gdung mchod zhe dgur rgyas phul gdung khang la/ /zhag grangs du ma khrus gsol kha phyebasatshe/ /ngo mtshar rus gdung thugs ljags spyan gsum lhag /de nas dpal 'dzin nye gnas rje btsun dang / /rig don dbang chen tshong ba gnyis po dang / /'od snang sogs kyi gros mthun khong nyid kyi/ /sku gdung mgo bzung shing bzo 'bos 'bos dang / /stong skor mgar ba dkon mchog skyabs sogs mgar/ /dpal 'dzin dbang chen khri 'du sku 'bum la/ /cha rkyen ched song gser dngul las bskrun pa'i/ /sku gdung thog tshad phyed gnyis khyad 'phags bzhengs/ /rig don shang gang nas 'ong gser nag gi /rnam bcu dbang ldan gdung chen steng du bzhag /yon dang ston mos dga' mgu ngoms par byas/ /stong skor lha bzo dge 'dun la sogs kyis/ /kun thub mchod rten sgo chung rnamasasu yang / /dus gsum sangs rgyas nyan thos gnyis dang bcas/ /129

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /sbyangs ba bla ma tā ra nā tha dang / /bla ma bsod nams rgya mtsho phur ba'i lha/ /lha mo rig byed ma dang phag mo dang / /rta mgrin thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa/ /'od dpag med dang rnam rgyal gdugs dkar dang / /'phag mchogs bcu gcig zhal dang rigs gsum mgon/ /kun mkhyen yab sras gsum dang spyan ras gzigs/ /tshe dpag med dang sgrol ljang seng gdong ma/ /rje dbon 'jigs med rgya mtsho mi zhabrugs pa/ /'phags pa klu sgrub sa dmar sprul sku dang / /chos rje sku 'dra sbyangs ba ma 'das dang / /sangs rgyas sman bla 'phags pa thogs med 'khas/ /bla ma tshul khrims nyid kyi sku 'bag rnams/ /che ba thog tshad tsam dang gyang lha rnams/ /sgrol ma nyer gcig lhung bshags lha rnams dang / /gnas brtan bcu drug sogs yod lha bzo rnams/ /yon dang ston mo sogs kyis mgu bar byas/ /130

rnam thar grugaganyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /de nas khong gi nye gnas rje btsun gyis/ /lo 'gar sngar bzhengs bdud 'dul mchod rten dang / /sgrub sel mchod rten dus 'khor mchod rten dang / /bkra shis sgo mang la sogs zhig gso dang / /rdo skyin zhal ba byas dang dkar rtsi gsol/ /steng du gyos 'gebs la sogs sbus legaba'ibyas/ /gser dngul las bskrun sngar bzhengs khong nyid kyi/ /sku gdung nang la gzungs gzhug 'bul skabs su/ /sbyangs sprul bstan 'dzin nyi mas srog shing btsugs/ /de tshe bla ma rnams la ye shes phebs/ /ring bsrel du ma khong gi thugs ljags spyan/ /rgya gar rgya nag gser sku bcu phrag lhag /khong gi dbu thod stod smad gzungs rigs dang / /gzungs chen 'bum phrag du ma lha sku mang / /gdung rus mang po rten gsum rigs du ma/ /dri med rnam gnyis tshad ldan gter bum rigs/ /gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i rigs dang sman sna tshogs/ /131

rnam thar grub gnyispo'ajo ba'i bum bzang /ser skya pho mo'i rgyan chas chu sna dang / /sa sna la thegags gzungs gzhugs legs par shākyab/ /sku gdung de dang sngar bzhengs mchod rten rnams/ /bla brang gser sku bka' chos 'bag sku dang / /'du khang slob dpon 'jigs med rgya mtsho yi/ /sku gdung byams sku chen mo la sogs pa/ /sku gsung thugs rten rnams la rab gnasayang / /'gro phan rgyas byed cho ga'i slob dpon de/ /chos rje mchog sprul bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / /gtsang ba'i rdo rje slob dpon chos thang gi /rdor slob mkhan po sogs dang mchog sprul rje/ /bstan 'dzin nyi ma bla ma rtogs ldan sogs/ /bla sprul bcu phrag zung gis rgyas par phul/ /grwa tshang yongs rdzogs dus 'khor rnying ba la/ /rab gnas btags te bla 'tshab rdo rje 'dzin/ /grwa 'khor du mas de nyid lnga par btags/ /nyin bdun rab gnas rgyas 'tshogs sbyin bdag kyang / /132

rnam thar grub gnyispo'ajo ba'i bum bzang /nye gnas rnams dang lha tshogasa'akhor bcas kyis/ /khri ba rnams la rta mdzo rasagur dang / /phrug lwa kheb si ther ma'i gzan sham sogs/ /ras kha dar 'bul grwa tshang yongs rdzogasal/ /bca' lag sgor mos thugs mnyesalegasamathar phyin/ /nyid thugs rdzogs phyir 'phags pa bskal bzang dang / /sher phyin brgyad stong rdo brkos gzimasakhang yang /bla brang bde ldan slar gso spyos 'gebs dang / /bar khang brjes te lha khang mchod khang byas/ /mdor na dam pa gang gi rnam thar ni/ /mi tshe gang bor dam pa'i tshogs phyogs la/ /nyin mtshan med par brtson pa lhod med mdzad/ /khong nyid dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rtags/ /tshul khrims dri bsrung sgo yi phyi nang sogs/ /kun la khyab pa ma 'dres mnyam por gsal/ /nang du gsang chen rtogs pa'i mdzod brnyes kyang / /gnya' shing gang tsam mig gis lta ba the(gas/ /133

rnam tharazub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /nyes byasaphra mo tshun chad bsrung sdom de/ /dus kun dro grang ngal dub ci byung yang / /chosagos rnam gsum skad cig mi 'bral zhing / /mtshan mo sku chingasami dkrol zas gos kyang / /ngan ngon tsam las mi dgos chog shes bsten/ /gzhan gyi bya spyod mi legs ci byas kyang / /thugs khro mi mdzad tha na sku lus kyi/ /zag pa sbyin pa'i sngags dmigs mi brjed pa/ /de 'dra dran shes rgyud ldan gnas pa sogs/ /thun mong blo ngor snang ltar rang bzo min/ /byis pa'i dusasu rat+na shrī yi/ /sprul pa yin zer grub chen myi bzang gis/ /shā ra'i bu red gsung ltar lo rgyus mang / /byis pa'i dus nas dgung lo nyer gcig par/ /nyid kyi zhal gsung de nas sum cu'i bar/ /gzhan gyi ngag ltar lo bdun chos 'grub gsungs/ /gsar brje skabs su 'bri rgyu cher ma chud/ /134

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /chos sgo phyesanasad bar rang gzhan la/ /gsal ba ltar dang nyid kyi gsung las/ /gong 'og nor nges de tsam ma gtogs par/ /rang bzo zol bstod gang med khong nyid ni/ /sbas pa'i rnal 'byor yon tan cung mi gsungs/ /rang cag yon tan mthong ba'i mig ldong bas/ /ji bzhin cha tsam brjod par nus min kyang / /nye gnas rje btsun bskul ngo ma ldog par/ /rnam thar sa bcad ma stong tsam 'di byas/ /gang gi gsang gsum rnam thar ma dros klong / /chu thigs tsam brjod dge ba'i cha mchis na/ /rgyal kun tshogs gnyis yon chab dang 'dres te/ /kun bzang mchod sprin mtshan ldan bla mar 'bul/ /dmus long gzugs la lta ba ji bzhin du/ /mkhris nad can la dung dkar ser po ltar/ /ma bshad logs bshad nyes pa'i rigs rnams kun/ /snying nas mthol bshags tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /135

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /mchog gsum bla ma'i thugs rjes bden stobasakyis/ /pha ma'i gtsor byas skye dgu ma lus kun/ /sham bha la dang bde ldan zhing khams su/ /mi ring myur nas skye ba 'dzin par smon/ /bla ma yi dam mchog gsum chos skyong tshogs/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras bden pa'i bkra shis gang / /bstan 'gro'i mi mthun rgud tshogasarab zhi nas/ /bde skyid rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i bkra shis shog /cesadapal ldan bla ma'i rnam par thar ba cha shas tsam brjod pa 'di nyid khong gi nye gnasabla ma rje btsun gyigabaskulab la brten mkhan da rdo rjesabrisapa'o/ /dge legasa'aphel/ /

rnam thar grub gnyisa'ajo ba'i bum bzang /nye gnasadam pa rje btsun gyis sbyin bdag byas/phyi shog mdzes 'god pa/mkhan gang bsam lhun grub/mgo log dpal skyabs/rtsis 'phrul pa/kun dga' tshul khrims/zhu dag pa/mkhar lha ldan/rtson 'grus dpal/rin chen/yid bzhin phun tshogs/dpal po/yig sgrig pa/mgo 41ga dpal skyabs/137
